notes.title: Some more fixes, Patchnotes for 1.5.8x
notes.notes:
I hope you're all doing well and enjoying your time in the game. Unfortunately the update we rolled out yesterday inadvertently caused a few hiccups. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience it might have caused. But hey, the good news is, we've just launched another update to fix these pesky issues and make your gaming experience even better!

Here's what's been sorted out in this latest patch:

[list]
[*]     Fixed the disappearing act of your Potion Paws Furniture items that went incognito after our previous update. If you also own potion paws you can now enjoy your beautifully crafted furniture once again!
[*]     You'll now spot dye icons in the corners of the UI for your dyed items. We wanted to make it less confusing for items dyed with the special dyes.
[*]     We've resolved the issue where swapping equipped items of the same type wasn't properly swapping them.
[*]     Exciting news for our multilingual players! We've added the incomplete/unverified fan translations from [url=https://www.localizor.com/garden-paws]Localizor[/url]. We believe that even if those aren't complete translations it can at least help make Garden Paws more accessible to other players. If you would like to help in the translation efforts feel free to check out our [url=https://www.localizor.com/garden-paws]Localizor[/url]!
[/list]

As always, we're immensely grateful for your patience and understanding! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Room Passwords Fix! Patchnotes for 1.5.8
notes.notes:
I hope you're all doing well and staying safe. We're rolling out a small update for Garden Paws. We know it's been a hot minute since we last dropped any new stuff for the game, and we wanted to say sorry for keeping you all waiting.

This update might be small, but it's mighty! We've squashed a pesky bug that's been causing some trouble with the password protection for multiplayer game rooms. With this update there should be no more hiccups there!

We've been heads-down and working hard on getting Potion Paws ready for prime time. It's been really shaping up, and we can't wait for you to get your paws on it! Also, for all our awesome Switch players out there, we're putting the finishing touches on a big update for the game on switch that's going to address some pesky issues that have been bugging you all for a while.

We also wanted to give a big shout-out to all of you for being so patient and understanding. Your support means the world to us, and we're incredibly grateful for every single one of you who's been a part of this fantastic community.

Thank you!

notes.title: Succulents, Bug fixes and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Seismic activity![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/32d6c22655d9fa418f85d1b2d7469e7acd4b2ff9.jpg[/img]

Another Earthquake has hit Florens! Thankfully this time it didn't cause as much chaos for the residents, but a new volcanic island has formed close to Kieran's camp!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/42a086e84d89da94df294235c7acb0b734e1f0a5.jpg[/img]

If you're in year 5 you will find this new island and close to it a new friend! Luiza and their giant turtle friend Sasha have come to Florens and can teach you all about Succulents.

[h1]New Crop: Succulents[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/8628790e3621412f7cf52eefc037403cd6fd1e12.jpg[/img]

Succulents are an exciting new plant you will now be able to grow. It comes in many different shapes and colors and are great for decoration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/950c075c5bbeedc048c2a77ee2e7f404f16d9e63.jpg[/img]

You can use them to craft new succulent furniture and succulent decorations or leave them on the ground to brighten your farm. To harvest and pickup succulents you need Garden Gloves, which Luiza can also teach you about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/828422a745b902e7209e9654774407cc134a822a.jpg[/img]

Instead of planting seeds, Succulents are propagated through succulent leaves. You first assemble a succulent tray to then grow a succulent seedling which you can then move to soil and grow into a mature succulent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/730b54a355ce90e8ee6c5dea69355fce3ed5443b.jpg[/img]

With Succulents also come Succulent Pets! You can trade succulent leaves with Luiza to receive a new Succulent Pet, there are many different colors and personalities to find so you can always come back to trade more!

[h1]Soil Remover[/h1]

Due to certain circumstances, tilled soil could become stuck in the game forever, so we added a new tool called Soil Remover. As the name suggests you can use the Soil Remover to turn tilled soil back into regular terrain ground.

[h1]Alphabet Workbench: Words[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/577ea452d11ee69151b2ef78e30054cf1a276f20.png[/img]

You can now craft different words in the Alphabet Workbench.

[h1]Fixes and Other Notes[/h1]

Huge thank you  to our discord mods and beta testers who have been helping us find/catalogue and confirm the bug reports.

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where Elizabeth's overalls would appear in the world before her shop is bought.
[*]     On the River Map, adjusted Egg #6 position so it's no longer fully underground.
[*]     Fixed an issue that caused snow to fall every day during winter on the River Map.
[*]     Fixed an issue that was preventing the crafting of "Paper Plants" in the Flower Workbench after the "Paper Plants" quest.
[*]     Fixed an issue that was preventing the crafting of the Cloud Foundation in the Workbench after finishing the Magic Beans quest-line.
[*]     Fixed an issue with the magic mannequin that would cause errors when using it with accessories.
[*]     It is now possible to sell the Fish Drying Rack
[*]     Harvesting message for the wheat field now says "Harvest Wheat Field"
[*]     Signs that would before say "Harvest Carrots" now should say "Read Sign"
[*]     Fixed some dialogue in some quests which didn't match what the quest was asking/trying to convey.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

notes.title: Animal Shop Expansion, Axolotl Breeding and more in this new Update!
notes.notes:
We hope you loved the latest update we brought to Garden Paws which featured the trick or treating in Florens! This event will come to Florens every Fall in game so don't worry if you missed it during the event this past couple weeks.

We are pretty excited to say we have another huge update already! This update features the animal shop expansion, axolotl breeding, two new crops, sushi and more! We originally meant for this update to be a quick small update but kept getting excited over new content and added a little too much. We hope you enjoy!

[h1]Animal Shop[/h1]

There's a new  shop expansion, the animal shop! This expansion will let you sell animals directly to customers and is available once you have the second shop level. These customers will offer you up to 10% extra coin for your animals and will have an optional request to add an extra item for a huge bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/95d3ed171461c72a9ef65251f66ad889f5745862.jpg[/img]

There is a new chick in town, the Silver Laced Chick! Following the cozy robe quest line Jones will share a surprise new addition to their shop. This chick can be raised and even bred to get unique coloured Silver Laced Chickens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/2794f98e7c65f49be1c065bf42ea5f06703e7a4a.jpg[/img]
[i]The new Silver Laced Chick.[/i]

[h1]Wheat and Rice Fields[/h1]

There are two new crops, rice and wheat. The wheat field and rice paddy are a permanent source of wheat and rice that does not need to be replanted and can be harvested every few days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/623b1b4d4f9d9d7f7d06bd014ab296ce10716cbe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rice Mill[/h1]

Once the rice is harvested it needs to be processed and turned into bags of rice, this can be done at the new Rice Mill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/6e300ad78096b4953a92c97ed8dc17a04e75d811.jpg[/img]
[i]Showing the new Rice Mill with Twitch avatars on the bottom of the screen.
[/i]
[h1]Sushi Station [/h1]

With the recent introduction of new fish, and growing your own seaweed and rice; we have decided to create a sushi station! You'll now be able to prepare fish and create an assortment of new sushi rolls. The sushi station is also where you'll turn bags of rice into cooked rice to use in dishes.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/c3b914adc980b13884ac392646f1b00b219397d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bouquet Seedmaker[/h1]

There is a new Super Bouquet Seed maker that can transform flower bouquets in a larger number of flower seeds! This quest line starts one year after Sammy gifts you the first seedmaker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9115296ab326098a524c1d5ac7ea9218a03cbe1c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Axolotl Breeding[/h1]

The Axolotl that came in with the last Garden Paws update can now be bred! The babies have a chance to be a random colour and size. There's a legendary secret to do with breeding this animal! Looking for spoilers head over to our Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/b9fdbf1a777e924f6ae7ae63c08ca8a6309ac71e.png[/img]
[i]You can now breed Axolotl's! The babies have a chance to come in many different colours and sizes![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/667d4433fbd233454941056cfa2553d891262af4.png[/img]
[i]Watching the sunrise with an axolotl![/i]

[h1]Magic Mannequin[/h1]

Splash shares a story through a set of quests that describes how a magician long ago taught their family how to make stone mannequins that could walk around! These mannequins can display any skin and wear any clothing items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/04432c9199f3f155a430cbd4591007c1b017c7d8.jpg[/img]
[i]Story time with Splash.[/i]

[h1]New Items[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/02b40a1f5bf804aad6ec8461bcfc873b76b92b27.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Cozy Robes[/b] - There are 5 new Cozy Robe items that can be crafted from alpaca fiber, delicate fur and wool! These robes can all be dyed. Once you complete the quests in town some of the villagers will be wearing these robes until 9am every morning!
[*]  [b]Pirate Chest[/b] - This new chest is coming in as a reward at Petey's Pirate Shop! It can obtained for 25 pirate coins.
[*]  [b]The Miners Hat and Spotlight[/b] can now be crafted!
[*]  [b]Large Food Storage[/b] - This new item can be obtained after the quest line with Jones and the new Silver Laced Chick. This item can be dyed with the furniture paint brush.
[/list]

[h2]Other notes/changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The legendary animals can now be washed with the water bucket if you dyed them...
[*] The Bean can be purchased from Frank multiple times.
[*] The Feather-light chest can now be painted.
[*] The grass now stays green for the first 10 days of fall.
[*] Patchwork skins have been moved from Splash's shop to a new skin shop in Halloween Island.
[*] More life has been brought to this update with more NPCs walking around.
[*] Long fishing times when fishing with low-fps have been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue with Twitch chat viewers disappearing from the bottom of the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Stylist Dress when using it with the Fox character.
[*] There's now an alert when you harvest seaweed from seaweed poles.
[/list]

[h1]Legendary secret from a past update ahead...[/h1]

In a previous update we added trading butterflies with Alberto and Malu for gliders and accessories but did you know you can trade 100 butterflies with Pamela to obtain a legendary butterfly mount that you can fly?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/e095f38185360b963277a4506b504a4469757ea3.png[/img]
[i]This new treasure chest can be purchased from Petey with pirate coins! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/692f2290adbe7e6bcf20e053f6484e5bb45ea2c0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Happy Halloween! Enjoy Trick or Treating in this Spooktacular PC Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/a67e6dfe223b0c4de1764565597fd910d1c34358.png[/img]
[i]Be sure to enjoy the breath-taking Autumn colours on a relaxing skele-horse ride![/i]

[b]Happy Halloween [/b]everyone! We prepared a [b]Spooktacular PC Update[/b] for you just in time for Halloween! This update features new [b]costumes, furniture, clutter items[/b], a new crafting method and a whole new [b]Trick or Treating event [/b]for fall!

[h1]Trick or Treat![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/30dcbad070eb4d949643ca99b8dc37319502ca3e.png[/img]
[i]Trick or treat, we want sweets, to get effects,  when we eats![/i]
[i]We’ll trade our wrappers, At the store, For new outfits, And decor! [/i]

The Mayor has come up with a new way to celebrate Fall in Florens! Now every[b] Fall between 20 and 30[/b] you'll be able to go up to everyone and [b]ask for candy. Eating the candy[/b] from trick or treating will give a[b] special effect [/b]that lasts a short while or even the whole day.

Save those [b]candy wrappers [/b]though because [b]Miah[/b], the new shop-keeper, will take them and give you new [b]costumes [/b]and [b]decorations[/b]! Miah can be found during the Fall Festival running around town with her Pumpkin wagon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/ded899a97f8181a92903905cc3471bf34865321c.gif[/img]

During this weekend we're making the trick or treating event available all year long in Florens. Come Monday we'll be changing it back to happen every Fall between 20-30 in-game days.

[h1]R.A.M. Printer[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/1536a720b3fedc97cf826730058208de3455896c.png[/img]

You can help Roman and the Mayor to acquire a great new machine for the town! The[b] Resource Activated Machine or R.A.M. Unit[/b] can turn [b]100 Plant Fiber, Stone or Wood[/b] into a beautiful item!

The catch is, each time you craft an item you need a Schematic or as Roman likes to call them, Chips! 
You can purchase [b]R.A.M. Chips[/b] from Roman for [b]250 coins[/b] but they can[b] only be used once[/b] so make sure to go see them if you need more.

The R.A.M. Machine can be used to create many different [b]new decoration[/b] and [b]clutter items[/b]! They look great in the shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/ffe02dbb6af7218d4fc3dd2cf57856c2cfbf018b.png[/img]

[h1]Axolotl[/h1]

A new animal has been spotted in the shores of Florens, you can now buy a[b] large aquarium[/b] from McCoy and tame the adorable [b]Axolotls[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/7bc7871191a3cf5eec3133a43f03b38471746ae5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

We're still working on adding some last minute items so you'll probably see some extra patches in the next few days. Have fun trick or treating and collecting all the new items this update brings and we'll be back with another update soon!

notes.title: Puzzles, Chipmunk, Bean House, Fish, Butterflies and more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Garden Paws is on the Switch! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4b27a60ce1fb41f345b160dd4e1bdcc40e07d350.png[/img]

Garden Paws is now on the Switch! The latest patch notes have been posted in the discussions.

Let's dive into what we've brought to the latest update for the PC! 

Now that the Switch has been released we, (devs Kristina and Dan), got so excited about adding content to Garden Paws that we got a little carried away and added a bit too much to the update.  At a certain point it got so big that it became a challenge to wrap up so we have created a rough content roadmap.

This update brings the legendary Bean House, Jigsaw Puzzles, the Chipmunk creature, 9 new Fish, 18 new Butterflies (wings and gliders), a permanent shop assistant and musical updates by our composer, Thiago Adamo.

[h1]Roadmap for Garden Paws[/h1]

Garden Paws has always been a game we enjoy playing as much as we enjoy making so we're happy to say we have lots planned for future updates! We are planning to add the Axolotl creature, new crops, a sushi station, and lots lots more. If you'd like more spoilers on what we've been working on, our Discord is the best place to find them.

We are very excited about enhancing the shop experience in Garden Paws. With the Animal Shop Expansion you'll be able to place animals in "for sale barns" in which customers will offer more coin than if you sold them at your shop tables. The customers may also ask for an additional item to purchase with the sale of their animal. If you choose to fulfill the customers request you'll be rewarded with a higher profit.

While we have no specific ETA on these exciting new features we hope this gives you a glimmer into what's in store for Garden Paws.

[h1]Magic Bean House[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9f35119b581c04ddf6f719295c6f652c552cfe68.png[/img]

There is a new epic house to obtain through Frank! It costs a mere 250,000 coins and because Frank doesn't mind if you spend all your coins on beans, you can purchase as many as you'd like! This quest line starts Summer Year 3 with Flo.

[h1]Jigsaw Puzzles[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/fb7347d1ab39b84f779e64f0c7cd71edeceb2819.jpg[/img]

Cai has joined Florens with dozens of puzzles to complete for Golden Puzzle Tickets! These tickets can be traded in for epic puzzle rewards including a unique chest, glider, planter and more! You can find Cai a few days into Spring and they'll be there year round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0833de16eaca09a89e338edcd50359cec0a66f62.png[/img]

[h1]9 New Fish[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/6868cdc9601491b68c8899f73b9b1ee1ac3ea22a.png[/img]

The waters are overflowing with new fish! Fisherman McCoy learned the secrets of chumming the waters and will teach you through a new quest line that starts in year 2.

The Chum also requires a new item to be crafted, the Worm! You will be able to find worms as a new drop from ferns around the islands of Florens while gathering plant fiber.

[h1]Fish Traps Reworked[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/f58ac5473f2a04df0dc412f1d5ccf010144c890b.jpg[/img]

The fish traps have been reworked for a more pleasant experience! The traps have a chance to catch something without having bait. Baiting will have a higher chance to catch better fish though. Additionally to pick them up you need to hold the action key instead of simply tapping it, preventing accidental pickups.

[h1]New Dungeon Weapons [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/75982bdc25ced6cd8570c3d52a3cb05a56ac8cba.jpg[/img]

For a while all Florens citizens had to protect themselves from the forces of the dungeon were wands, but recently the mysterious shopper in the dungeon started stocking a magical sword in their shop. The sword still fires magical projectiles when you swing it, but you get to look way cooler while doing it!

Along with the sword there is a new fire wand to purchase from the shopkeeper for 25,000 shards as well. These two new items do a base damage of 20 compared to the base wand at 15 and the ice wand at 18 damage.

[h1]New Creature: Chipmunk[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/3695bc137d693c398eadd6665a4f2f8e74d96389.jpg[/img]

There's a new creature in the game, the Chipmunk! The Chipmunk can harvest fruit trees and berry bushes for you and will store them in their habitat. The quest line to obtain the Chipmunk starts with James.

With the chipmunk comes new items! Around the pine trees in the game you now will have the chance to find acorns, that can be used to tame chipmunks or sell. When destroying trees there is now a rare chance of obtaining a tree trunk that can be used to craft a chipmunk habitat, sell or decorate your house.

[h1] New Butterflies, Accessories and Gliders![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/fa43abf5986a2e6e70ea13b96145157bd9f18a6a.png[/img]

There are a lot of new butterflies to collect! They can be used in your face accessory slot to follow you around. Malu and Alberto have new questlines to make new butterfly wings and gliders based on the new designs. Once you have the quest lines done you'll be able to trade 10 butterflies for the butterfly accessory or 50 butterflies for the glider.

[h1]Music and Audio Updates[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4b6c7468e7c1fc9d788b623ebcb169a73c81c5cb.jpg[/img]

Our Audio Lead, Thiago Adamo, fixed many audio bugs and added new songs to the major parts of the game. This update also brings the amazing instrumental feats of the Saint Petersburg Studio Orchestra to the Dungeon Boss music and the work of the talented Italian Cellist Federico Puppi to the new theme song!

[h1]More to find in this update![/h1]

[list]
[*] 9 New Fish that can be obtained from chumming the waters which McCoy will teach you in  year 2.
[*] Fish Traps Reworked - You can now catch something without having bait, but if you bait your traps you'll have a chance for better fish.
[*] A dungeon sword has been added in replacement of using a wand. This can be purchased from the shop for 25,000 shards and deals a base of 20 damage.
[*] A fire staff has been added to the dungeon shop and can be purchased for 25,000 shards. This deals a base of 20 damage.
[*] Glow Tortoise and Molten Dragon types have been added.
[*] Hatchery bar should no longer show up when you're looking away.
[*] Stone platform should now be able to have items placed on it.
[*] Geode Processor now has an auto deposit option.
[*] Butterfly garden now has a pickup all option.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the blue mystery box from being clicked until the fish came up.
[*] Fixed a bug that resulted in invisible customers coming to the shop.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused penguins to drop from foundations placed underneath their habitat.
[/list]

notes.title: Human Character, More Saves, New Items and more!
notes.notes:
We are introducing a new character, [b]The Human[/b] as a free Garden Paws DLC. We have decided to introduce the character in this way so that if anyone doesn't want human character in their game they can simply not download the DLC.

The character DLC is also bringing in [b]several new hair styles[/b] that can be used on any character. These hair styles [b]can by dyed[/b] and can be placed in the existing hair equipment slot or the [b]second hair equipment slot[/b] that has been added with this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/95cab9331240421dbe3cad2e66bd2e39852bb6a9.png[/img]

[b]The human DLC can be downloaded right from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/959812/Garden_Paws__Human_Characters/]Steam here[/url].[/b] We'd love to hear what you think about this character and hope it brings new life to your Garden Paws game.

[h1]New Special Dyes[/h1]

[b]Malu[/b] has a [b]new quest[/b] which leads her to opening up a new shop [b]selling special dyes.[/b] The dyes change clothing items, accessories and hair styles. The special dyes include the [b]water, galaxy[/b] and a series of [b]void colours[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/a9fc94479bb5c8572588d636ef4c95c47b911441.png[/img]

[h1]New Kozita Items and Changes[/h1]

There are [b]2 new items[/b] that can be found in [b]Kozita[/b]; the [b]Dragon Habitat[/b] and the [b]Gem Pillar[/b]. To obtain the items you must [b]trade Dragon Statues[/b] to Mina or the miners.

These items can be painted with the [b]furniture paint brushes[/b] to change the color of their Crystals and when the gem pillar is painted its light changes colors as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/2f3e007ef93f412fef59ba6fbb4ccca2cedf40f4.png[/img]

We have updated the[b] locations of the Dragon Statues[/b] so they're slightly easier to find as well as increased their size. The [b]Dragon Eggs[/b] have also had an [b]increase in size[/b]. Happy searching!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/6cb41f45ecf148d0863d9673afb9e7835755dcda.gif[/img]

[h1]New Save Slots[/h1]

Listening to many [b]player requests[/b] there are now [b]5 World[/b] and [b]Character slots[/b] available! That should help players that already had 3 worlds but wanted to explore the [b]new River Island map[/b] that was released in the last update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/bb0407c560c9d9e4a72c68e556857dc7fc80c531.png[/img]

[h1]New Wooden Building Pieces[/h1]

There is a new set of items to unlock from Roman that make great building pieces! These include [b]bridges[/b], a [b]ramp[/b], a [b]pillar [/b]and a new [b]wooden tunnel.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0af1a7e18874d1987c077dc29795debe04110a08.png[/img]

[h1]New Paw Hotbar Slot[/h1]

When you have a hotbar full of tools it's sometimes annoying to accidentally swing your axe at customers at the store when you're simply trying to sell them items. With the new [b]Paw Hotbar Slot[/b] you can run around without swinging your axe or scaring away all your customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/956e89e169731554034c1326f5d116087157cd32.png[/img]

[h1]Modding Updates[/h1]

We're always excited to see what the talented players in the [b]community [/b]have been coming up with in the new[b] Steam Workshop[/b] section! There have been many [b]new skins,[/b] [b]faces [/b]and even new [b]craftables [/b]and [b]quests [/b]shared there! If you haven't checked it out yet [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/840010/workshop/]you can find the workshop here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/35b458db164a18f1a2a64981a031f7d872bece62.jpg[/img]

In this update we've made some changes both to the [b]modding system, mod manager[/b] and the [b]skin tester tool[/b] to make the creation of mods even [b]easier[/b]. 

In case you haven't checked out the modding tools yet, here's [b]how to find[/b] the [b]ModManager [/b]and the [b]Skin Testing tool[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/3ee19dba20db41ee81524f45b7402b75ed9cc615.png[/img]

This update also makes some changes to make it even easier to create [b]clothing items[/b] for the game, we've created a little[b] instructional video[/b] on how to do so:

[previewyoutube=RBnDwzj41PM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Here are other changes made to the modding system:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The [b]Skin Tester Tool[/b] can now [b]import models[/b] to be used as [b]clothing[/b]. It comes with some models that are [b]pre-made [/b]and available in the game without having to import it into your mod. This includes [b]Dresses, Sweater, Shirts [/b]and more.
[*] It is now possible to [b]paint skins [/b]and [b]clothing [/b]items directly inside the Skin Tester Tool
[*] When importing clothing there are options to [b]fine tune [/b]the placement of clothing items, and a button to [b]automatically create [/b]the necessary [b].json [/b]file for the item with those values.
[*] It is now possible to [b]Launch the game[/b], enable/disable [b]modding console [/b]and enable/disable [b]modding sandbox [/b]straight from within the [b]Mod Manager [/b]app.
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Winter terrain visuals [/b]have been updated. The [b]first 10 days[/b] of winter will have a grassy snow terrain, as well as the last 10 days of winter. Days 11-19 will remain the same as it was.
[*] [b]Forest habitat [/b]now takes [b]dark [/b]and [b]fairy dragons[/b]. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]Hatchery [/b]that sometimes prevented progress on hatching.
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]Crafted Beehives[/b] that prevented it from giving honey.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the [b]White Shirt[/b] to showing up on the player.
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]Ruins Puzzle[/b] parts/door not moving.
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]Stained Glass Tortoise[/b].
[*] A [b]new face[/b] has been added to the game.
[*] [b]Sierra [/b]now sells [b]6 items[/b] instead of 3.
[*] The [b]new purchasable house[/b] in town can now be [b]painted with paintbrushes[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: New Map, Steam Workshop and Switch Update
notes.notes:
[b]The dev team; Dan, Kristina and Thiago[/b], want to give a [b]HUGE Thank You[/b] to everyone that has been supporting us making our dream game over the past little while. Your steam reviews, twitch streams,  tweets, feedback, and really everything is so helpful at making Garden Paws as good as it can be. Spreading the word about Garden Paws brings in more people and let's us continue to work on it, adding new content and expanding the GP world, so we just wanted to say how grateful we are. The game wouldn't be what it is today without you. Alright, time for the important stuff.

[h1]Switch Update[/h1]

Starting with the [b]Switch update[/b] we're happy to say [b]Garden Paws is running smoothly[/b], all quests are working, bugs are squashed and visually it's really pretty (at least we think so). We had to change the water and grass to be optimized for the Switch while keeping the Garden Paws feeling. We went through the entire project and removed anything that drained performance as well as optimized textures, shaders and anything else we could find. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9861fb2fce3690b6dd007a17f557f28c2b32aece.gif[/img]

We've sent it in to Nintendo and are waiting to hear back, if all goes well we'll have great news soon. Many people ask for an eta and we're sorry but we still don't have one as it depends on the certification process.

[h1]New Garden Paws Map[/h1]

This has been in the works for a few months now and we're ready to ship it out to players! This[b] will not [/b]replace your current map, it is a completely [b]separate map[/b] option to play on. When you create a new world you now have the option to select the "Classic Map" or the "River Map". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/53407658c95ae57df8558b5d9c176a535c9ff918.jpg[/img]

This map has many similarities to the Classic Map, the main differences being the player home and town locations. On the River Map the town has moved to where the player home used to be, and the player home has moved to a more central location with a beautiful view of town and the surroundings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/12c7833ce0cc7803efad2c4887a2cfd02e2c7dc4.png[/img]

Pamela has also moved closer to the player as opposed to being on a faraway island. Geographically the map hasn't altered too much apart from the forest and small changes. 
We hope new and old players will enjoy the refresh this map brings to Garden Paws.

[h2]Tips for playing the new map: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Start with a brand new character for a fresh start
[*] Bring your character and some workbenches to the new island for a speedy beginning
[*] Bring your character but drop off your coin by turning your coins into bags with Mayor Wilson
[*] Want more tips? Join our [url=http://www.discord.gg/bittentoast]Discord to chat with the Garden Paws community! [/url]
[/list]

[h1]Other additions to this update[/h1]
[list]
[*] There are a few new dragons flying in, including the monarch, snowflake, and galaxy dragon.
[*] There is also a new Tortoise to find, this is the stained glass tortoise. It has a 30% chance to spawn from a regular tortoise egg.
[*] The castle interior items can be moved using the hammer. This has resulted in a slight visual change.
[*] The owl nests are larger and have moved, making them easier to find.
[*] Bred Horses now keep their colors after growing up.
[*] Sierra now sells decorative flower display trays that can hold up to 20 flower items.
[/list]

[h1]Steam Workshop and Modding[/h1]
Steam workshop is live! We are excited to see what mods become available to the Garden Paws community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/da405c0cc1fde9d11d502766109d2b6722667451.jpg[/img]

We had the ability to make your own character skins since Day 1 but we've now added it to the initial game files. If you'd like to make your own skins you can find the [b]Skin Tester Application[/b] and files in the same folder as the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/866b0c53ab1efd422d1ca88d68cd938103b4bdb2.jpg[/img]

To access this folder from Steam head to your [b]Steam Library[/b],  right click Garden Paws then access [b]Properties[/b]. From here click on [b]"Local Files"[/b] and then [b]"Browse"[/b]. 
This will open your file explorer with the location of the skins and the [b]application "GPSkinTesting"[/b].

[b]Please note: Custom skins will not be visible to other players to ensure Garden Paws is family friendly. However, if everyone in the lobby has the skin installed from Steam Workshop you will be able to view it on other players.[/b]

[h1]New Plushie![/h1]

We're excited to announce our [b]Rainbow Dragon Plushies[/b] are available! They have some beautiful details to perfectly capture the in-game Rainbow Dragon. The plushie is 17cm tall, super soft and squishy! There are limited quantities, if you'd like one you can find them in our [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/shop/BittenToastGames][b]Etsy store[/b][/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0240b4e1ddeb7d0e0a3bad348b5aa2dfec14aa1a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Links[/h1]
Etsy: [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/shop/BittenToastGames]https://www.etsy.com/ca/shop/BittenToastGames[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/GardenPawsGame]https://twitter.com/GardenPawsGame[/url]

notes.title: Farm Plots, Tortoises, Breeding and more!
notes.notes:
In this next update we're excited to bring you more creatures to breed, the tortoise, farm plots and more. We have been having a great time connecting with the community through Twitch and have added Garden Paws avatars for everyone to use while streaming! Twitch integration can be activated by typing in your channel name, once you are connected you can turn on "viewers on bottom of screen". 
Your chatters will be able to interact by typing "hype", "love", "jump", "dance" and do other fun emotes while you're playing! They can even change their character by typing in the character type, (Ex. Dragon).

We recently did a stream on Twitch play testing Garden Paws on the Switch and are glad to say it's running smoothly! We can't share much past that other than Switch is getting closer every day! We really appreciate everyone's patience as it's been much more difficult than we presumed with how large Garden Paws has become. Huge Thank You to this amazing community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/f4e4e49a2c3d1dd33660a86de96a335aa5dc54e1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Breeding; Horses, Pigs, Goats, Ducks and Dogs[/h1]

There are 5 new creatures to breed, the quests will start with a letter from Poppy. These creatures are the same as the past creatures that we're able to breed meaning they'll have many different colours and size variations when bred!

[h1]New Creature : The Tortoise![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/8fb35a9607e132e701e4396d97a4e4792c3358b3.jpg[/img]

Kozita has a new egg to search for, the Tortoise egg! This egg has the same mechanic as the previously introduced owl and dragon creatures. Once you've found the egg simply place it in a Hatchery, take care of it until it's an adult and then ride it around!

[h1]A new Dragon egg with 13 new dragons to hatch![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/aec1f8e0e2d8ceb632ace126fa70f6b12192898b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0c98bdf84b877fbb95c6a5f341315079e909d29d.jpg[/img]

Who doesn't want [b]more dragons[/b] in what started as a shop/farming simulator! We're so glad we have this amazing community that enjoys the fantasy creative world we've built and are always expanding! With that our developers got a bit carried away and made a few more dragons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4b02c2bcc2fdbc4785fb54f262f828dc1635dda5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/d6f372c888d8ca63087abd4ab522f1996e5cd7bf.jpg[/img]

[h1]New items; farm plots, heart couch, bridge, stone block[/h1]

With farming being such a large part of Garden Paws we wanted to introduce Farm Plots! These plots come in 4 different sizes and come with their own watering systems! The farms can be painted with any wall paintbrush to make your farm your own! These items can be purchase from Sierra or crafted after the elizabeth quest line.

Other new items added and how to find them:
[list]
[*]  Animal Planters: found at Sierra's shop from day 1.
[*]  Heart couch and chair: Can be purchased from Herb on Kozita.
[*]  Building Stone Blocks (2) : Crafting blueprint is received after a quest that starts with Elizabeth. 
[*]  Stone Bridge and Stone Overpass : Crafting blueprint received after gaining Stone Building Blocks.
[*]  Door: This door can be built from day one and can be opened and closed by interacting with it.
[*]  New Cooking Recipes: Dragon Fruit Cake, Baked Eggplant, Blueberry Cake, Devilled Chicken Egg, Devilled Duck Egg.
[*]  Turtle Succulent Statue: Can be purchased from Herb on Kozita.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/5937a9c5d667cfe1f6ec9b84f8163b526cf22a4d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/3825c8b9a3c6e72cab3a6535d1a30c4c5235b720.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/80ebee919202e86d999c26882230dec27818af23.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's your favourite part of the update? Let us know in the comments![/h1]

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Kozita expanded! Dragons, Owls, Optimization and more!
notes.notes:
This update is packed full of both[b] optimization improvements [/b]and [b]content[/b]! As we've been working on bringing the game to the Switch we had to take some time to tackle[b] optimizing the game[/b] for a different platform, and this update for the PC makes full benefit of that, with considerably [b]lower memory consumption[/b] and running much [b]smoother[/b].

[h1]Gamepad[/h1]
The changes made to the [b]gamepad controls[/b] for the Switch version have now been implemented into the PC version as well. If you already play the game with a gamepad you'll notice a lot of improvements with all the[b] inventory actions[/b] accessible via gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0a14bd75b895873c82d9d1ec0892b38221aeddfe.gif[/img]

There are new button [b]shortcuts[/b] and a new [b]item selection menu[/b] that gives you [b]extra options[/b] when handling items including a way of splitting items with precision.

The game now also shows the correct key prompts in the UI based on your controls configuration.

[h1]New Creature: Owls and Transport Baskets[/h1]

In this new update every winter you might start noticing some [b]nests [/b]showing up around the forest. Every day of winter there's a [b]small chance[/b] that a[b] Snowy Owl Egg[/b] will appear in one of those nests. Picking up an egg starts a new questline with Poppy to build an [b]Egg Hatchery[/b] that can be used to hatch Snowy Owl Eggs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/610b7ae7530357529fb5e2fabc629acde4456dde.png[/img]

The eggs require to be [b]cuddled [/b]once a day for [b]5 days[/b] to hatch into a [b]Baby Snowy Owl[/b]. After 10 days of either being cuddled or eating [b]Small Fish[/b], it will mature into a [b]Snowy Owl[/b].

There's a new Boris questline that follows the large storage quest that will unlock a [b]Basket Blueprint[/b]. This Basket can be combined with a Snowy Owl to create an [b]Owl Transport Basket[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9cc56347e76ee1f72836dd111b00111a1f359107.gif[/img]

Owl Baskets can be used to [b]transfer items[/b] home. Any item placed in the Owl Basket will be flown to the home chest, this works anywhere even if you're on Kozita! In case the home chest is full the remaining items will attempt delivery at every in-game hour. 

[h1]Kozita Expansion[/h1]

The Druid has discovered how to handle [b]Kozita's Thorns[/b] and with your help they will start a new questline to get rid of them. This questline will ultimately give you their clothing item, the[b] Leafy Coat[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9f1e6871cd5e59f2663609e02953c2f5cbd9e95c.png[/img]

Once the thorns are gone you'll be able to explore the rest of Kozita, meet the [b]Kozita Miners[/b], the [b]fisher Roe[/b] and [b]Mina[/b], the Dragon enthusiast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4ff2d4ca62e9b3abef5f8a238aec1c98b76eab9c.png[/img]

[b]Mina[/b] is a big fan of Dragons and likes to create and hide Dragon Statues across the island. They will trade any Dragon Statues you find for [b]Dragon-themed decoration items[/b] and eventually even [b]Dragon Eggs[/b].
[b]
Jasper[/b], the miner, on the other hand is interested in the gems Mina uses to craft those statues and will trade any Dragon statues you find for [b]gems and ores[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/eeb5139a84aad5ce41e65f2f7515bd350955386d.png[/img]

There are [b]20 Dragon Statues[/b] scattered around the island [b]each in-game year[/b] for you to find. Mina can tell you how many are left for the year if you ask them.

[h1]New Creature: Dragons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/ae86adf11839fac961f45de47ec462bf9bfa4dbf.png[/img]

Dragons are a great new addition to the Garden Paws [b]mounts[/b]. They're the only mount that can not only [b]glide[/b] but also[b] Fly[/b]. Every day in Kozita there's a chance a [b]Dragon Egg[/b] will be in one of the nests scattered around the island.

There are[b] 5 different[/b] Dragon Eggs that you can find in different times of the year. Each season has a dragon egg and there is a rare chance to find a [b]Dark Dragon Egg[/b]. Each egg has a few different dragon possibilities that can hatch from it. With some being rarer than others.

Dragon Eggs can be placed in the [b]Egg Hatchery[/b] and take[b] 15 days to hatch[/b]. Dragon Babies take [b]25 days [/b]to mature.

It's a lot of fun braving the skies of Kozita with the Dragons. When in the air you can press the jump button to fly. The same [b]stamina wheel[/b] that appears when you're swimming appears when you're flying, with a wing icon in the center while flying is active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/053d9b13562e77f7047e7c93bd6c25339d61c2cb.png[/img]

[h1]New Creature: Elephants[/h1]

Dragons aren't the only new animal coming into Garden Paws with the expansion of Kozita Island you'll also find Elephants that you can tame! They can be tamed with Hay and can be used as mounts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4fa09484b8f1defc4be1c52171f3d5d01b929279.png[/img]

[h1]Breeding - Alpaca, Cow, Fox, Bunny[/h1]

Poppy is back with more breeding treat recipes! With this update the Alpaca, Cow, Fox and Bunnies can all breed adorable colorful new animals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/f7252a6c943baf65219d9a663708cf7bba3f54de.png[/img]

[h1]New Loot Chests for Late-game players[/h1]

When you get to year 3 you'll start noticing better loot coming out of the Chests you find around the island. From large stacks of resources to random Decorations or even Animals, you never know what you're going to find when opening one of these new chests.

[h1]More New Items and Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0eed066aa95990196a57c029186c42ca55d8e7b1.png[/img]

[h2]Superior Furnace[/h2]
The Superior Furnace can hold stacks of up to 50 at a time as opposed to 10 of the regular furnace, making it easier to set up items to smelt and forget about it going to do other things in the island. This can be obtained through a questline with Beltran in year 2.

[h2]Ghosty[/h2]
Ghosty is an adorable little ghost that follows you around when placed in the Face Slot of your equipment inventory. It can be traded for 25 pumpcoins in Halloween Island

[h2]New Kitsune Fox skins[/h2]
Splash can now sell 3 new Kitsune Fox skin variations, Purple, Green and Blue.

[h2]Flower Sprinkler (In Winter with Pamela)[/h2]
In Winter Pamela can now trade Snow Drops for a Flower Sprinkler, that has the same range of the Gold Sprinkler with a cool flowery visual.

[h1]Other Fixes and Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] If you're zoomed in on the map you can now click and drag the map to move the map view around.
[*] Crystal Paw and Birch Glass Shelf are now dyeable
[*] Guitar has been fixed and can now be played again.
[*] Four Christmas sweaters that were missing from Dasher's shop have been added to Dasher's shop.
[*] The Grey ferret can now be placed in the Ferret's Habitat
[*] Music no longer overlaps after you change islands.
[*] Pegasus and Skeleton Horse can now be placed in any stables.

notes.title: New Island, Treasure Hunting, and German Translations!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4ba1eac7bb948aa9e1d372439f948d8e68439cc4.jpg[/img]

In this update we have added a huge new area for late game players to explore. Once you have reached [b]year 4 [/b]in game you'll be offered a quest line with Conrad and Frank to bring you to the new island: Kozita. Once you have landed on [b]Kozita [/b]you'll be land locked for a few in game days while you meet new NPCs and get new equipment like the [b]Kart and Raft[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/295d5ebdbdb393c0410415c2ff6d186464ba29c4.gif[/img]
[i]The Kart and Raft in story mode![/i]

This new island has new items to gather including [b]Raspberries, Limes, Pineapples and 7 lavender colour variations[/b] with new cooking recipes to unlock as well. There are a few new quests on this island including a quest line to build an [b]Animal Sanctuary[/b] which will create fence-less homes for creatures. Once you have built a specific creatures sanctuary you will be rewarded with a unique creature or item. (For spoilers on what the sanctuary rewards are we have a [url=https://www.discord.gg/bittentoast]spoilers channel on our discord[/url].)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/a5769f024a7c15a58caaab670d6921cf2912bf2d.gif[/img]
[i]Herb the Kozita Seed Seller can be found selling new seeds including Pineapple and Lavender Seeds![/i]

When you are on this new island all tames and crops will be paused but time will continue, for example if you want to escape Winter in Florens head over to cozy Kozita.

You may notice some other islands across the thorns when you land on Kozita, these are areas that will be unlocked in future updates with new creatures and new quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4708aff4137beda7a4d04ac44e6515bd6ebb7e83.png[/img]
[i]The new pineapple crops![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/36199d406650f1f661264805318a0e8d7b2293ce.png[/img]
[i]There are 7 new types of lavender to be collected on Kozita[/i]

The new island is also bringing 7 new variations of lavender. These seeds can be purchased from [b]Herb the Kozita Seed Seller[/b] and even turned into[b] bundled crops or bouquets.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/d062d733208725a2ff560b1679085bd192a1c9fe.gif[/img]
[i]Catch Conrad exploring Kozita[/i]

Characters on the island of Kozita are as curious as you are and can be found wandering around or sitting and enjoying the view. You may even catch some farting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9e6df1cde7ae3b7481672f55a53a5bde36806afa.png[/img]
[i]A completed sanctuary[/i]

[h1]The Treasure Update![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/73555045276a7a13223ffd9f0e470a03a3b63528.png[/img]
[i]Petey the Pirates house and shop![/i]

We had a bit of fun with this update adding [b]treasure hunts[/b]! You'll be able to collect [b]map fragments[/b] through quests, bottles you find on the beach and by fishing. When you get the [b]Cartography Table[/b] from Petey the Pirate you'll be able to piece together the map fragments to form a [b]Treasure Map[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/5fd94ba3ccaca68ea54676b8f21c7ba74b5057ea.png[/img]
[i]The Cartography Table![/i]

Use the treasure map, (when it's in your hot bar), to reveal a [b]glowing trail[/b] pointing you towards the buried treasure to dig up. The treasure can be coins, items, clothes or even the dungeon items to help you get those museum collections completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/a526ec99e94e3e30f139387a9161db28a08a1697.png[/img]
[i]Purchase new items and goodie bags with your golden treasure coins![/i]

[h1]Translations[/h1]

[b]HUGE thank you[/b] to everyone in the community that has helped with translations over the past few months, we're excited to say we've started implementing the languages with our most translated language first, [b]German[/b]!

The German translations have been 60%+ completed by the community! We were waiting till a language was 100% completed but as there are frequent updates we found it better to add the language as it is, anything [b]not translated will remain in English[/b]. This has been community translated so there may be grammatical errors, spelling mistakes and slight inconsistencies in the objects/quests. We have had the translations scanned by a translator to search for any inappropriate language and thanks to this amazing community it's clean and ready to  share with the public.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/3a859b68687806db2fc7db4b7fdee38d874ad4d1.png[/img]
[i]To change the language go to Settings and then Change Language.[/i]

[h1]Other Notes[/h1]
We have been asked a few times if we would[b] increase the story mode max players from 4[/b]. While the game play, content and rewards are not balanced for 5+ people we have decided to add the ability to create rooms for[b] up to 10 people in story mode[/b]. We will be adding an in game message that the game is not balanced for this amount of players and you may get through the quests and other content quicker. If you'd like to play with 10+ players,  you can play with up to [b]32 players in Creative Mode[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/fd7bfc809f2c7ac23921f20e5773ffbf04af7347.png[/img]
[i]New outfits and accessories![/i]

[list]
[*] New outfits and 2 new sets of wings.
[*] Energy obtained from food has been adjusted.  You roughly obtain energy roughly equivalent to 10% the sell price of the item. (Something that sells for 100 = 10 energy, 50 = 50 energy and so on.) When in the dungeon you obtain HP instead of Energy. 
[*] The bouquet recipes for the hydrangeas and pink leaf flowers have been added.
[*] This update has many bug fixes and we're always optimizing the game, sorry we're terrible at recording each fix. Between Dan and Kristina we forget to record each bug. If you find a new bug please let us know and we'll fix it. :)
[*] Plant fiber seed now has a price and can be sold or dropped on the ground.
[*] Some grammatical mistakes in quests have been fixed. 
[*] Bug fix: Fixed a bug that was preventing Splash from selling the hedgehog skin.
[*] Bug fix: Fixed a bug that was preventing the earthquake cut scene from being shown.
[*] The Bear Rainbow Skin colour name has been corrected. 
[*] Added save button if you would like to manually save the game.
[/list]

[i]What's your favourite furniture set? Our latest favourite is the Birch set, when you paint it the colours are pastel![/i]

[h1]New Creature: The Hedgehog[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/9c0aace5b647d770991a2586679c8e41fccc0567.png[/img]

Looking for a cute addition to your farm, once in a [b]Forest Habitat[/b] it will bring you one fruit a day. It can be obtained from any rare drop that can drop an animal, (Memory Game, Blue Mystery Crate, etc), and can also be obtained by completing one of the [b]Museum collections.[/b]

[h1]New Quests and the Bulk Bulletin Board[/h1]

We heard you missed some of the bulk orders from Conrad so we have added a few more[b] (20+) quests[/b] for Conrad and if you're looking for more there is even a quest that will get Frank to build you a [b]Bulk Bulletin Board[/b].

This Bulk Bulletin Board will act similar to the one in town but ask for a[b] large quantity of items[/b] including cooked food, furniture, animals and even high end tools. If you complete a quest from the new bulletin board you'll earn [b]30% more coin[/b] than if you sold it in your shop!

You can only take[b] one bulk quest a day[/b], and if you don't like the quest that day just wait until tomorrow for a new one.

[h1]Museum[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/57c331e27eb382d4a4d1e3c4fe822863f2ea9fe0.png[/img]

The museum has [b]new collections [/b]to complete! There is also a new[b] Cloud Glider [/b]that can be obtained from a collection! We added the dungeon collections as well, if you're not a dungeon diver but want to complete the collections we recommend trading with other players.

[h1]The Largest Dungeon Update Yet[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/2ab5b6c9790564a1d2ceb10047470acf20e33d64.gif[/img]
[i]The dungeon is a great in multiplayer and we find it's easier and more fun with friends![/i]

How are you enjoying the dungeon? In this update we have added [b]24 new items[/b] for you to collect and craft! The[b] boss drops[/b] have also been improved with new rare items to gather. Not only can you gather the new items but certain levels will reward you with raw resources including; plant fiber, geodes, wood, stone and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/268fa1bac5c510b54a0d39b72ac7e3204c85a4ce.gif[/img]
[i]Battle your way to the boss for great loot! Each boss has unique loot drops that varies each time you battle them![/i]

The [b]dungeon monsters[/b] now match their environment, depending on the level you're in. We plan on expanding this in the future further with unique bosses and more mob variations.

[b]Dungeon Crops! [/b]You can now plant the Dungeon Leaves, Dungeon Shroom, Dungeon Vine, Leafy Fern, Pink Petals, and the Dungeon Flower. These are key elements in the [b]new healing powders[/b] which you will unlock the deeper you dive into the dungeon.

[b]Taming Wands![/b] We've also added the ability of taming the dungeon monsters! Once you reach certain levels of the dungeon [b]Hash [/b]will start selling blueprints for taming wands for [b]shards[/b]. Taming wands can then be crafted in the Dungeon Workbench and can be used to tame a monster. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/0c0c524a05c1bf7e0dd3755809977fb63e64b2a0.gif[/img]

notes.title: 100 Dungeon Levels, Castle, Skunk, Fishing 2.0 and more!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3.8 is now live! This update is [b]packed full of content[/b]! We're really excited about this update we've added the 100 floors of the dungeon and will continue to work on it for future updates. We have added new tools, furniture sets, a new creature and more! 

We made a small video showcasing this update. If you like the video update let us know and don't forget to share it with your friends. :) We have posted this video on [url=https://twitter.com/GardenPawsGame/status/1248378065748549632?s=20]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/bittentoastgames/videos/551033655541118/]Facebook[/url] as well.

[previewyoutube=vAb51FsQsdE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]From the devs..[/h1]

We, [b](Dan and Kristina)[/b], wanted to let everyone know that we are working on Garden Paws and it is our main focus, we have started the process of getting Garden Paws on the [b]Switch but have no eta[/b] at this time. We are also working on Potion Paws at the same time but want to reassure the community that we are working on Garden Paws. 

A little bit about us, we have been making games for years and find we work best with taking creative breaks. Potion Paws and another game we recently made ([b]Farting with Friends[/b]) allow us to be creative without feeling burned out. (Yup we're weird, our breaks are us working on other games.)

We are just letting the community know as we've seen some concerns brought up that we're working on multiple projects at once. We understand your concerns, but rest assured we are giving [b]110%[/b] to both games.

P.S. If you want to download [url=https://danielsnd.itch.io/farting-with-friends]"Farting with Friends", for free you can do so here[/url]. It's a [b]multiplayer game[/b] we made in a couple days where you play as a cute skunk, (yup the one coming into Garden Paws), and your goal is to knock out your friends by farting on them. During these hard times we find it's a great silly game to play with friends, so we wanted to share it with everyone.

Sorry for the rambling, let's jump into this update.

[h1]The Dungeon is complete! ...kind of[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/62d237dc3e8bd4efd6a7c1ac0d428d8c691de617.png[/img]
[i]The new Ice Dungeon features new versions of the old enemies and a whole new Furniture Set![/i]

In this update you can now play past the first 10 dungeon levels all the way [b]up to level 100![/b] We have added the [b]Ice Furniture [/b]set, a snazzy [b]Ice Cape [/b]and an[b] Ice Wand [/b]that does a little bit more damage.

You can play up to level 100 and you'll notice [b]environmental changes[/b] and [b]stronger monsters[/b] as you progress but we haven't added all the bosses, furniture sets and monster variations yet. We plan to expand on the dungeon in future updates.

A little tip for [b]dungeon divers that want a challenge[/b], try shooting the mushrooms on the right when you enter dungeon from smallest to largest. Or was it from largest to smallest, it was one of those two options. By doing so you'll enter [b]hardcore mode[/b] where you will have less hp and the monsters will be stronger, but hey [b]more loot[/b]!

[h1]Birch Trees and Bee Hives[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/977eee5dfc7c00eea0ca892c1b59457eaf597e4f.png[/img]

We are pretty excited about a new gameplay feature, growing your own [b]Birch Tree Farm[/b]! Once you have built the Tree Farm for Bruce, they'll be able to start selling you [b]Birch Tree Saplings[/b]! It will take several days for the tree to mature, but once it does you can chop it down for [b]Birch Wood[/b] and a chance for rare item drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/d609f2aad08f705ec92fb3865d007b75d3476cdf.png[/img]

The rare items you can get range from seed mystery boxes to bee nests. The[b] Bee Nests[/b] are a new item you can use to craft your very own [b]Bee Hive[/b]! This hive acts similar to the natural occurring bee hive, where you can gather a honey or honeycomb once a day. We heard you want less of a honeycomb grind, we hope this helps.

[h1]Birch Furniture [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/ffefb4fff7b701808a41bfba22d4a36be0c2191d.png[/img]

Now that you have all that Birch Wood you can use it to craft one of the many new, and profitable [b]Birch Furniture[/b] items! These items can be painted with the furniture paint brushes, and when painted they'll be in soft [b]pastel colours[/b].

There are some new [b]Birch Bonsai Trees[/b] and other great new items to find in game.

[h1]New Upgrade: The Castle[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/e5c7e98602b2e3020e82ee754e2c6e26287f3cd3.png[/img]

Once you have commissioned all of the town upgrades you will be able to commission your very own [b]Castle from Frank![/b] The Castle comes with plenty of room for your building needs, a new workbench with new castle furniture and even a special pet!

By purchasing this upgrade you're also showing you're the best and the mayor has granted you permission to build anywhere in and around the town.

[h1]New Upgrade: Cosmetic Tools Shop[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/5f1598d6dda851ac71227cd1bf2ff0676df37444.png[/img]

Once you have upgraded your tools to Gold you will be able to invite [b]Cosmo[/b] to open a shop in Florens. Cosmo will sell variations of the gold tools with a cosmetic flair.

There are currently [b]20 cosmetic tool variations[/b] for you to purchase in styles ranging from [b]ghost [/b]to[b] flowers [/b]and more. We plan on adding more tool variations in the future,[b] let us know[/b] in the comments what kind of tool variations you would like to see.

[h1]New Creature: The Skunk[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/a094096315d5e01304abc189faaff2cb10b72950.png[/img]

Remember that game "Farting with Friends" that we mentioned? When we made the [b]Skunk[/b] character we fell in love with it and had to add it to Garden Paws.

Not only this creature is really cute, it's also [b]useful[/b] in your farm. Once tamed the skunk will drop lots of poop and even [b]fertilizer[/b].

The Skunk can be found in the [b]forest[/b] biome, is tamed with [b]chicken eggs[/b] and will be at home in the [b]Forest Animal Habitat.[/b]

[h1]Fishing 2.0[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/023a3982d3dfc9583aad00185f369507d56c496c.png[/img]

We have made some tweaks and improved fishing, starting with [b]two new upgrades[/b]! The Silver and Gold fishing rods will [b]reduce the catch time[/b] and increase your odds to collect rare fish, while decreasing your odds of collecting trash.

We have added a few[b] new rare fish[/b] for you to hunt down as well, these fish are too pretty eat but they sell for some nice coin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/5bf519c62cf97d93bdcc9af5b2717ab92d92c99e.png[/img]

There is also a new [b]Trash Fishing Rod[/b] that is by far our favourite. It will only hook bottles, soggy paper, fertilizer, glass, seaweed and have a rare chance for mystery boxes and other "trash" items that we're sure you're going to enjoy.

The Fishing Experience has also been improved with a rare chance for[b] mystery boxes[/b] to pop up while your fishing.

The gamepad has some significant improvements to make fishing more enjoyable and relaxing. When you use the gamepad you simply pull the joystick in the direction of the fish and click to catch it.

Let us know what you think in the comments!

[h1]New Item: Stone Sprinkler[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/87d158d2c5a8db7dcccc38799fd1b6672f29d402.png[/img]

After seeing some gameplay and hearing feedback from the community we've noticed the sprinkler can be hard to obtain early game, if you're not looking for it.

To make the game more enjoyable your grandparents have sent the [b]Stone Sprinkler Blueprint[/b] in your first Summer in Garden Paws. It will act the same as the copper sprinkler in terms of radius, but will require different resources to craft.

We hope this makes the game less of a grind and more enjoyable for those looking to start Garden Paws again from the beginning. :)

[h1]There are too many emotes so... Emote Wheel![/h1]

We had a bit of fun making some [b]new emotes,[/b] but found we had too many and forgot to tell people about them in general. (What you didn't know you could fart with ".", have a chance to poop and then sell it to your customers? Yeah we added that crucial feature.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/f7e02d6c0ff5fd53be206311b59510c6bd49a68b.png[/img]

[b]If you hold down Z an emote wheel will pop up! [/b]The emote wheel features the emotes we already had in the game plus 2 new emotes, the wave and the pout!

[h1]Gamepad Improvements[/h1]

As a part of the Switch porting process we've been reworking the Gamepad controls for Garden Paws. This update should fix a lot of the gamepad issues pointed out by players and improve gamepad gameplay overall.

If you find any problems with the gamepad play please let us know so we can address the problem.

[h1]Other notes:[/h1]

We possibly missed some of the updates and bug fixes we did for this update, but here's some of the stuff we did that we remembered to write down.

[list]
[*] Several multiplayer issues have been fixed.
[*] Copper, Silver and Gold sprinklers radius' have been slightly increased (to a 20% larger radius). The stone watering size is slightly smaller than the copper.
[*] Loot Chests now have a chance to contain better rewards
[*] Some stacks have been increased from 1 to 10
[*] Jellyfish prices have been increased by 25 coins.
[*] The Silver Pickaxe, Silver Axe, Gold Pickaxe and the Gold Axe sell prices have been increased.
[*] Beetles now have a rare chance to drop fertilizer.
[*] Hippos now can drop piles of poop (3x poop)
[*] Bulletin Board Quests now should be able to be tracked.
[*] Fixed the Dungeon Shop in multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed the Jetpack in Creative Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented animals from being fed if they moved too far from their spawn spot.
[*] Fixed Chess Piece position reset not syncing correctly in multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue with the snow flashing on foundations in winter.
[*] Fixed an issue with the grill when 2 different type of fish are on it.
[*] Fixed an issue with Halloween Island chests not respawning correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with skins and equipment not dropping with the correct drop rates on the loot chests
[/list]

[*] [b]Paintable carpets and paintings[/b]. The wall/floor paintbrushes can be used on these (60+ patterns).
[*] Accessory Item: [b]Unicorn Horn[/b] 
[*] Accessory Item: [b]Antlers [/b]
[*] Accessory Item: [b]6 new wings[/b] (swirl designs and bee wings)
[/list]

Huge [b]building system update[/b]: The hammer and item shifter now have a [b]"Selector"[/b] option. By clicking this you can select the item you'd like to interact with.  

[b]Potion Paws [/b]crossover items have been added. The 26 crossover furniture items are just for owning Potion Paws in the same Steam library. You'll receive the workbench in the mail on day 2 in game. Potion Paws Kickstarter Exclusive Cat with Cape Keys have also been sent out. 

[b]26 crossover furniture items[/b]
[b]Cat Ghost Pet/Mount[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/62b32c1eb5733b93a77b05d1cd8333d952fc5c5e.png[/img]

[h1]Fruit Trees and Berry Bushes![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/a850929ce6955c43fc9c89bd6f07f487389dd907.png[/img]

[b]Apples, Oranges, Lemons, Cherries[/b], oh my! There are 4 fruit trees that can be found around Florens and the nearby islands. Each season there will be a new tree type in the wilds, if you don't want to wait for the wild fruit trees you can [b]plant your own[/b]. Each tree even has a rare chance to [b]drop seeds[/b] when being harvested.

These new fruits can be used in one of the many new cooking recipes at the cooking station or oven. There's more! You can now find [b]Blueberry Bushes[/b] in the wild as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/f9d3281b221c301439829172aa9169fda1695e40.png[/img]

[h1]Potion Paws Crossover Items [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/c61b70ba0e6b109ab972bda806d344e7276e6f1d.png[/img]

We're happy to say we've added the Potion Paws crossover items. We added even more items then we originally set out to add. There are [b]26 furniture items[/b] to decorate with! You may even find the [b]Cat Ghost[/b] mount lurking in a cave that you can befriend with some stardust!  You can tame as many of these as you'd like.

If you own Potion Paws in the same Steam library as Garden Paws you'll receive in-game mail containing the [b]Mysterious Potion Table[/b] blueprint. Once you've crafted this workbench you'll unlock the rest of the Potion Paws crossover items.

[h1]Custom Painting and Carpets[/h1]

We've added two new items that can be painted with the wall paintbrushes. This will open up over [b]60 painting variations and 60+ carpet styles[/b]. This upgrade can be purchased from Roman after you've unlocked the Painting Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/45225f704dd0decab146dc9b39914e45e7736f3c.gif[/img]

[h1]Building System Update![/h1]

The Building System received a huge improvement in this update. When placing a piece, using the hammer or the item shifter there is now an option for opening a "Selector". When in selector mode your mouse is visible and you can mouse over different buttons on the UI to select what socket or building piece you want to interact with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/3863ee8e07d7a89a0d05f86baa436732626b15ea.gif[/img]

This makes it easier to build faster and make less mistakes. It also makes mistakes easier to fix since with the new selector menu you can hammer out even the hard to select things like the sprinklers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/d2ea2d5e80dfcf60182936f89311036e7e291165.gif[/img]

[h1]Pamela's Trading Center[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/531f8766276503b3aa7a6dad4a6096b8f32b3e6f.png[/img]

Pamela's Trading Center has finally opened its doors to the people of Florens. You can find the big tree trunk on Ferret Island. Inside you will find [b]Pamela the Unicorn[/b]. Pamela doesn't use coins and instead prefers[b] trading items[/b] for their wares.

[h1]What's next for Garden Paws?[/h1]

We've got big plans for Garden Paws including adding more levels to the [b]Dungeon[/b], and even a[b] huge new island[/b] to explore and more! We welcome you to join our discord or follow our twitter for spoilers as we work on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228384/4e309584622e8ab71ca19b2f82076717d1d7a86b.gif[/img]

We originally set out to release Garden Paws on the Switch this December, but have to ask the community to wait a bit longer so we can get the game to be the best it can be without rushing. We hope you understand we are working our hardest to get the game to the Switch without cutting content we would love to see in Garden Paws.

notes.title: The Dungeon is in Garden Paws!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Dungeon is in Garden Paws![/h1]

You may have noticed there has been a dungeon in Garden Paws for the last couple weeks. We might have forgotten to write an update, sorry about that. Hope you're enjoying it! If you're not a dungeon fan, don't worry the [b]dungeon is not necessary[/b] to the main game and can be ignored.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ccb825fb0988569ea694dc4b75ebf3d746f0e67c.gif[/img]

The dungeon currently has 10 procedurally generated levels with the 10th level being the [b]boss level.[/b] You can collect dungeon specific loot here and familiar items including geodes, plant fiber and coal. You can also collect shards that can be used to [b]purchase goods from the shop [/b]floor on level 11.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/1b93dbe3a1849493b7dd15f45c6fd0f7a2a13772.jpg[/img]
[i]The Shopkeeper doesn't always have the things you're looking for...[/i]

The dungeon shop contains a dungeon [b]exclusive furniture [/b]set, the [b]Dungeon Stone [/b]set and a [b]rare cape![/b] If you still have spare shards, don't worry you can exchange them with Hash for coins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ebdeca13cbaa21e1bfa6d19fda44f1e433b052fe.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/de98ccc0749b58c02fe9640286b362fae60cdf5d.png[/img]

There are also relics in the dungeon to make each run exciting and different. Some of the [b]relics[/b] increase damage, speed and even loot gained!

We plan on adding more levels to the dungeon in the future with more [b]monsters, bosses, loot [/b]and all that good stuff.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/56ae5caf20441378820b26cdae7fcdc3813d32bd.png[/img]
[i]You can find exciting loot chests in the dungeon![/i]

[h1]Secret Hardcore Mode![/h1]

Think the dungeon is too easy? You can increase the difficulty with a [b]hidden puzzle.[/b] When you first enter the dungeon (before going into the danger zone), you can shoot the blue mushrooms on the right wall from [b]smallest to largest [/b]to activate hardcore mode.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/00790a77c211427d9745abaf9081ef1eceabe7e0.gif[/img]

The [b]hardcore mode[/b] reduces your HP from 250 to 100, increases the damage the monsters do and increases the loot drops.

[h1]What's coming next in Garden Paws?[/h1]

We are pretty proud of how far Garden Paws has come this last year, especially with a small team of 3 (2 Developers and 1 Composer). Over the next month(s) we plan on adding the [b]Fruit Trees,[/b] a [b]new island[/b], new tameable [b]creatures[/b], the rest of the [b]dungeon[/b], and a [b]new NPC [/b]that will have a shop with various decoration items.

We're always working on optimization and will be focusing on this pretty heavily as we start the port to the Switch. Our goal is to have Garden Paws release on the [b]Switch December of this year![/b]

notes.title: The Summer Festival is here!
notes.notes:
We have a lot to cover in this post, we just did [b]2 new updates[/b] this month ([b]1.2.8[/b] and [b]1.2.9[/b]) and we (Dan, Kristina and Thiago) have a lot to share with you!

[h1]Summer Festival[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/0dc41d9ecba1bf18b40ff196d1545a9cfb818f74.png[/img]
[i]The Summer Festival and its 3 minigames[/i]

If you enjoyed the [b]Easter Festival [/b]we have a great surprise for you! When you reach summer in the event area of the town you will find a brad new [b]Summer Festival[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/2b4fd03326ea6f4edf51b0c06eb201214dd0e0e8.jpg[/img]
[i]Balloon popping, lawn mowing and memory game![/i]

In the Summer Festival you'll find [b]3 new mini games[/b] with great prizes! Each mini-game gives you [b]Summer Tickets[/b] that can be used to purchase Mystery Boxes that will give you a random prize when opened.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/1bfa3215860e50d334e9cfbc1146c92dfe1132a5.jpg[/img]
[i]There are a lot of new items as prizes! Shorts (9 Variations), Tankini (9 Variations), Floaty Accessory (5 variations), Skirt (4 variations), Flower Lei and Marshmellow on a Stick.[/i]

We also have new [b]summer inspired[/b] furniture pieces coming with this update, including a [b]Diving Board[/b] that functions like the Trampoline.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ee9f157ace9fec82aa58cbf9029523371e2cf471.jpg[/img]
[i]BeachBall, Beach Chair (6 Variations), Picnic Table and the Diving Board[/i]

With these updates you will also find Roman selling some new blueprints that will unlock [b]6 Fence variations[/b]! These fences are also shorter then the one currently in Garden Paws, and are 1 foundation long.

[h1]Trading Cards and Steam Badges[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/6184e4da44a7b7bab8f0b299c85c00bda6909995.png[/img]
[i]Which one is your favorite?[/i]

We now have new[b] Steam Trading Cards[/b] in the game, 1 for each of the playable characters. You get them by playing the game or[b] trading [/b]with other players.

[h1]50+ New Quests[/h1]

We heard you want some more quests, so we've added [b]59 new quests[/b] in these updates. These quests are focused towards late game players mainly being [b]bulk order quests[/b] or quests that unlock after specific [b]blueprints[/b] have been purchased.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/d21d0d4126e086b00b4066780308f2f0e82aa6fa.png[/img]
[i]Hopefully you've been stockpiling items for these new quests![/i]

We are still working on the[b] new map[/b] that will come in with [b]2 new towns[/b], [b]100+ unique quests[/b] and more. Catch us in [url=http://www.discord.gg/bittentoast]Discord[/url] or on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bittentoastgames]Twitch[/url] for spoilers. (Eta for the new map is August.)

[h1]Four new NPCs[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/b715d3b2ba10cbafe22a10d5653c59fed4ff885b.png[/img]
[i]Jack Uzzi, the hot-tub salesman[/i]

There are four new NPCs to be found, one is [b]Guppy[/b]. Guppy is located in the Inn and will sell you grilled fish once the Inn has been built. We also have [b]Jack Uzzi[/b] the friendly Hot Tub salesman that shows up in the Summer Festival along with [b]Sunny[/b] the Summer Festival organizer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/c8c523c0a69e7fb0c2ae61392d4717ed58f8c341.png[/img]
[i]Hash the guild master![/i]

The other new character is [b]Hash[/b], who is the guild master and has been sent to [b]Florens[/b] to keep the monsters in the dungeon inside the dungeon. You can find Hash in the [b]new cave[/b] that has been opened near your home on your way to the forest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/f3ddb8e34850ac341e1f28a143e27817eb687a75.png[/img]
[i]The new cave which will also be home to the entrance to the dungeon coming soon![/i]

The dungeon is a completely [b]optional[/b] part of Garden Paws and will be implemented towards the[b] end of July[/b].

[h1]Bubbles and Wands[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/c5eab887c380a1518dc10c32f16d1c5dea1a6dc6.png[/img]
[i]Always carry your wand with you, you never know when you'll see a bubble around.[/i]

If you head over to Hash and have a chat, you'll [b]get a wand[/b] to practice with while the dungeon opens. Want something to practice on? Try shooting some [b]bubbles[/b]. The bubbles are pretty rare, so keep an eye out. You'll have a chance to find them floating above the water, (usually near seaweed), and once you [b]pop them[/b] they'll drop a [b]mystery box[/b] that can be opened for a treasure.

[h1]Bugs and adjustments:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Most of the items that stacked to 30 now stack to 50.
[*] Paper has been added to the bouquet table.
[*] Ferret and Dung Beetle collections now count towards achievements.
[*] The black cat was being fishy but has been fixed and can now be pet and will bring items properly.

The dungeon will be optional and you won't be technically "killing" the creatures for anyone that is worried about blood/gore. If you don't see your name here please send us a message, we did have to remove a few that either weren't appropriate or were promotion links. We will be adding a bit more to the credits in the next update, including the community members that made skins for Garden Paws.

[h1]New Quests, New Shop and New Items[/h1]

This update our main focus was squishing bugs and improving the the QOL (Quality of Life) for Garden Paws. We did manage to squeeze in a few new items, another upgrade and over 20 new quests. This brings us to 500 Quests currently in Garden Paws!

[h1]Fishing Shop[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/9ba712f00007ef91f24b62aad83a6259dcad6e25.png[/img]

[h1]Paw Path and Animal Display[/h1]

[h1]No Harvest Zone[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/6d013e9f053b543f5fd805d9e64cbda76e73efab.png[/img]

A small but big new item is the "No Harvesting Sign", when you place this item it prevents anyone from harvesting within it's radius.

[list]

[*] The Inventory has an[b] Auto Sort[/b] option, as well as a[b] transfer all[/b] button.

[h1]Bug Fixes and General Tweaks[/h1]

Want to chat with the [b]developers (Dan, Kristina and Thiago)[/b] or this [b]amazing community[/b]? Here are some of the best places to find us.
