notes.title: Tame every animal in Garden Paws AND MORE!
notes.notes:
Our focus for this update is to make every animal tameable and we're happy to say we've done it and we've added MORE animals to tame with great benefits to your farm!

We've updated the taming as well to include the feed the animal likes above their head, as long as you're holding one type of feed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/d715b76961843d78998e521949281ab05b7487c7.png[/img]
[i]The arctic fox and it's love of small fish.[/i]

[h1]Foxes, Ferrets and Beetles![/h1]

We added the Foxes, Ferrets and Dung Beetles in this update! All with really great uses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/5e727a71afb239fb4cf385fda010ce1ae5f9ed30.png[/img]
[i]Foxes! Once tamed they'll bring you a fish a day, or just some poop...[/i]

Let's start with the[b] Fox.[/b] The Fox can be found in the forest area and can be tamed with Small Fish. You need to pick up a [b]Forest Animal Habitat [/b]from Roman the Blueprint Vendor and give the fox a nice home for it to stay with you.

Once you have the fox tamed you can visit it every day to collect some fish, or some poop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/b79978629e55c91a28998a7d5c9b0a72bcaa1f95.png[/img]
[i]The ferrets make a great addition to any farm. They'll collect feathers, furs, eggs and more every day for you![/i]

Next up, the [b]Ferrets![/b] The Ferrets are something Kristina, our designer, really wanted to add since she grew up with them.  Simply purchase the [b]Ferret Habitat [/b]and grab some [b]wool [/b]and you can head off to start taming these little ones.

The ferrets can be found on one of the southern islands, or in the ruins. Once you've got them tamed they'll [b]collect all [/b]Fiber, Wool, Fur, Feathers and Eggs in the area!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ff792d3453339b0b67934cf9c46acae3eb0e47af.png[/img]
[i]Isn't this one stinking cute habitat?[/i]

Last but not least, we've added the[b] Dung Beetles[/b]! Once you have collected [b]100 poop[/b] you'll be able to build a [b]Dung Beetle Habitat[/b] (it's stinking cute!) and craft some [b]Beetle Feed[/b]. Once you have some beetles tamed and in their habitat they'll start collecting all the poop within the area the next day!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/6501c1099fdf6a378c87090cdc5f80f5e0d495c5.png[/img]
[i]The beetles come in tons of different colours, even rainbow![/i]

The beetles come in [b]6 colour variations[/b], and if you choose to pursue the [b]Beetle Mania[/b] achievement and tame 100 beetles, the Legendary Beetle will have a chance to spawn! This [b]Gold Legendary Beetle[/b] is even a mount and can be ridden around the map!


[h1]Unicorn[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/e384e7f7b632a61900137c63dbf1fa0ca462e4da.png[/img]
[i]Rainbow Glitter Unicorn anyone?[/i]

You may remember from on of our past updates that we mentioned the Unicorn coming in and we're happy to say that day is today! Call us Unicorn-y but we went with a classic rainbow design, gold horn and ALL the[b] glitter[/b]!

The unicorn has a [b]1% chance to spawn everyday[/b], when you see the rainbow you'll know it's out there, somewhere. BUT you'll only be able to tame the unicorn when you have some [b]Legendary Feed[/b] that you get from activating another Legendary to spawn. (Don't worry the fastest legendary to trigger is just by collecting 100 poop.)

The [b]Unicorn[/b], like all legendary creatures, is a little bit faster then regular mounts and a little more ... legendary.

[h1]New Animals[/h1]

We added some new animals, and some variations to existing ones. Here's a little list of some of the new animals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/9fe23e2ff141159ad0e3f48827d344e11f01a407.png[/img]
[i]The new black cat![/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Arctic Fox[/b] (doesn't show up every season ;) )
[*] [b]Black Cat[/b] (tamed with fish)
[*] [b]Mountain Goat [/b](tamed with Hay)
[*] [b]Black Horse[/b] (Roaming the lands)
[*] [b]Pigs and Piglets[/b]! (Poppy's Shop)
[*] All sheep can be tamed! (Black, White and Pink)
[*] New Black Bear variation (tamed with Honey)
[*] You can tame the Deer
[/list]

[h1]Want another Barn or 10?[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/cdaa13641d2a8575f13231cc1dae9735b1536576.png[/img]
[i]The new barns![/i]

We've heard you want to raise more barn animals. We've added a buildable barn in this update! You'll receive the [b]blueprint in the mail[/b] your first winter and you can start building barns to hold up to 4 animals! If you need some Hay we've also included a blueprint for a [b]Drying Rack[/b] to turn Tall Grass into Hay.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

There are new poop achievements, all the achievements have also been added to the[b] in game menu[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/8b26fbeb7b64eed2c651fa04460ad1d82c11b158.png[/img]
[i]You can now keep track of your achievements progress in-game.[/i]

[h1]Twitch Integration Update[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/3baac0213ae6e6fe8be8daf775527fd73645db22.png[/img]
[i]With Twitch Integration you can enable emotes to pop up above their heads![/i]

We've updated Twitch Integration a little bit. Your chat can now type "[b]hype[/b]" to pop some confetti (this can be disabled). Chatters also have a chance to appear as an animal in the wild.

We've also added some NPCs to the [b]Town Hall and the Inn[/b]. When you enter your chatters will appear as those characters. Chatters can type "dance", "dab", "jump", or "fart" while they're characters in your game!

One last update, people in your chat can choose the character type they'd like to spawn as in your world when they're a customer.

[h1]Bugs Fixes and Other Info [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/debbe87d3dad994bb2bb5e0937159659643ac990.png[/img]
[i]The re-textured hippos <3[/i]

[list]
[*] The [b]Fish Traps[/b] don't get picked up when you harvest from them.
[*] The[b] Flying Carpet and Kart[/b] have been added to the Creative Mode.
[*] There is a [b]Storage Workstation[/b], all "Storage Solutions" have been moved there.
[*] There are 3 new [b]poopy achievements[/b].
[*] Creative mode update: The odd buildings have been removed.
[*] The Queue in the[b] oven [/b]has been increased from 1 to 5.
[*] The food item that a [b]wild animal [/b]wants now appears above their head.
[*] The [b]hippo[/b] texture has been adjusted to look less piggy.
[/list]

[h1]How to find the devs: [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/1f7bfdc90c205958e9da87486405fee2efeb2ba7.png[/img]
[i]Yup you can find Dan and Kristina streaming on Twitch, taking suggestions, giving spoilers and just having fun![/i]

Want to chat with the devs or get sweet sweet spoilers? Here are some fun links!

Discord: [url=www.gardenpawsgame.com/discord]www.gardenpawsgame.com/discord[/url]

Twitch: [url=www.twitch.tv/BittenToastGames]www.twitch.tv/BittenToastGames[/url]

Twitter:  [url=https://twitter.com/GardenPawsGame ]https://twitter.com/GardenPawsGame [/url]

Facebook:  [url=https://www.facebook.com/bittentoastgames/ ]https://www.facebook.com/bittentoastgames/ [/url]

A [b]HUGE Thank You[/b] to everyone that has supported us in creating Garden Paws. The community around our little game is incredible and we appreciate you all so much.

Daniel, Kristina and Thiago

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/762996c073addc82d040008e66a4b5c7d720e703.png[/img]

notes.title: A Creative Update with lots of New Furniture, Items and Legendary Animals!
notes.notes:
[h1]Our One Year Anniversary! [/h1]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/f983ef3d60cd1245949d5e5c016e3b6bfb398d96.gif[/img]
[i]So many people running around the maze![/i]

If you follow us, well anywhere, you'll know that [b]June 12th[/b] was our one year anniversary. Yup that's the day [b]Dan and Kristina[/b] started conceptualizing Garden Paws and asked our friend and composer [b]Thiago[/b] to be apart of the project shortly after.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/2a913c4b3d7199baf7e4a453ac5c5b2d5079506e.gif[/img]
[i]DJ Penguin in the house![/i]
 
We  had a TON of fun on [b]Twitch (BittenToastGames)[/b], yesterday playing on a 32 player dev server with this great community. We had silly dance parties, explored the procedural dungeon, and gave away prizes around the maze, trampoline jump puzzle and more! It was a great test run to see how our game would hold up with larger server sizes, which brings us to Creative. 
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/33f1a637483969cdb4d71893b1f709da32338dc5.gif[/img]
[i]Easter Festival![/i]


[h1]Creative Mode[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/1b2b92c0cf941ffde020af67792e64912ccf309e.png[/img]
[i]Thanks Creylith for creating this epic jump puzzle in the creative mode![/i]
 
Creative is something we've always wanted in Garden Paws, and larger server sizes. We're happy to say the[b] 10 player creative servers [/b]are running really well in our limited tests with the help from our beta testers and will be coming live in the next couple hours.

In creative mode you'll instantly unlock all the items and are able to build anywhere and everywhere. There's no town and no quests, just room for you to roam.

[h1]Legen... wait for it.. DARY Animals![/h1]

[b]Kahuna Chicken and the Big Bunny[/b] can be found roaming the islands, once you prove your worth as a tamer of that animal type you'll be able to find them in the wild.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/6bced7b449f52fd048c208d67bd1e2112daed740.png[/img]
 
Without giving too many spoilers, a certain achievement might have something to do with it. Want more spoilers we welcome you to our [url=http://www.gardenpawsgames.com/discord]discord that has a #spoilers channel[/url]. P.s. Any bugs with the [b]Steam Achievements[/b] have been[b] fixed[/b], and new achievements have been added.


[h1]2 New Furniture Sets![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/594b4fdbde768db7ce462f5f67fdc0d59b1649b5.png[/img]
[i]Chilling in the Heverli Hot Tub[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/244f5362c99ab394a4e86c5d9f7b0a9030a95a8b.png[/img]

Thank you [b]Hash and Teewie[/b] for these sets coming into Garden Paws, we've already seen the community  over the moon about them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/8e35827100b4ced375e402ffbd8b60d74cb94634.png[/img]
[i]Going to tame all the bunnies with these big carrots![/i]

With the [b]Seed Bundle Station[/b], you can now combine 4 seeds and 1 Fertilizer to create a[b] Large Seed Bundle[/b]. When planting this seed bundle you'll notice it looks a little bit larger than other crops. This [b]Super Crop[/b] will yield a seed when harvesting, and you'll have a chance to find a [b]Seed Mystery Box[/b].

Over at Bitten Toast we love Mystery Boxes, how about you? Would you like to see more [b]FREE[/b] Mystery Boxes in Garden Paws in the future?

notes.title: A Colourful Update! A Natural Disaster, New Gliders, Dyeing Station and lots more!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patchnotes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] - There's an Earthquake event! Along with 50+ New Quests. 
[*] - Bees!! New items: Apiary, Bees, Honey, Honeycomb 
[*] - New Painting Station! You can now create dyes and paintbrushes to paint walls, floors, equipment and building pieces! 
[*] - SeedMaker! You can use the Seedmaker to turn fully grown plants into seeds! 
[*] - You can own a new cave that offers delivery of coal, geodes and a brand new Crystal Geode! 
[*] - Boris has new inventory upgrades for sale (Max inventory +11). 
[*] - Catch bugs with bottles! You can craft bottles (or clean old bottles). 
[*] - Fast-travel with mine-carts (locked behind quest). 
[*] - Craft All Button 
[*] - 10 New Gliders, purchaseable from Alberto (quest locked) 
[*] - There is now an option in multiplayer to share store profits or not share store profits. 
[*] - The new Town Hall now shows up in the world and can be entered! 
[*] - New area: 2 new caves to  unlock. 
[*] - New Recipes! (Popcorn, Cookie, and Icecream) 
[*] - New item: Crystal Geodes that drop gems. 
[*] - New item: Flower Planter - New item: Guitar! (purchase from Clovis) 
[*] - New item: Item Shifter (used to nudge placed objects) 
[*] - New item: Ramp Curved In/Out (purchase from Roman) 
[*] - New item: Paintings (craftable at the paint workstation) New item: Paint Decorative Crate (achievement locked) 
[*] - Abby now sells vegetable seeds 
[*] - Updated window position on building piece. 
[*] - Fixed being able to right click to remove stones out of the stone delivery crate.
[/list] 

[h1]A HUGE update![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/1678e3e184dad9af573d22065c705a496937aeed.png[/img]

First off a [b]HUGE Thank You[/b] from the team ([b]Dan, Kristina and Thiago[/b]) for all your wonderful support, kind words, reviews (good or constructive) and hanging out with us in discord or on stream. We appreciate this[b] community[/b] so darn much! A [b]shout out[/b] to our [b]beta testers[/b] and everyone that has given advice, suggestions and let us know about any bugs they've found.

There's WAY too much in this update, but it's definitely one of our favourites so far! We've got tons of photos for you, and if you've caught any of our recent streams ([url=http://Twitch.tv/BittenToastGames]Twitch.tv/BittenToastGames[/url]) we've been sharing lots and lots.

[h1]A Natural Disaster![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ec39695cbf7d36090e88306e50d98a118e6ef1db.png[/img]

If you've already loaded up the game and you noticed a ton of shaking, [b]don't worry[/b], it's not a bug! That's the [b]earthquake[/b] that hits (or will hit) middle of year 2. When the earthquake hits you'll be able to help out the townsfolk, (with [b]over 50 quests[/b]!), and even help repair the tunnels to open up the [b]Fast Travel[/b] between the Town and the Campgrounds. 

[h1]Fast Travel[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/af5b7cd80df665a1d088c82e164ad122abb38edd.png[/img]

Tired of getting around on your glider or a mount? With this update you'll be able to work with the miners and repair the mining tracks to open up a fast travel between the town and the campgrounds!

[h1]Bees and Bug Catching[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/009deb11a00f4c6cc1e9f492de44f77d1e4f1c68.png[/img]

Bzzzzzz we've got some news! We have implemented catching bugs (and butterflies with bottles) and you can even have your very own [b]Apiary[/b]! Once you get some [b]honey[/b] you'll be able to make some [b]cookies[/b] and more items in the future! This is the first step towards taming bears, which will be implemented in the coming patches.

[h1]Paintbrushes, Dyes, and New Stations![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/51546780b7d711302bed0119807255019ec6711a.png[/img]

Let's start with paintbrushes! There are [b]9 Paintbrushes each with 3-6 colours/patterns[/b] to paint your walls, floors and ramps with. These are craft-able at the [b]Paint Station[/b] which you can unlock after you purchase it from Roman the Blueprint Vendor. 

There are also [b]9 Furniture Paintbrushes[/b], these are used to paint almost all the furniture, planters and workstations in the game. With this brush you can even paint the [b]Crystal Furniture[/b] and the [b]Glass Walls[/b] and Floors!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/e00cb9e9017c6076972c2a2824906798a60bb7f4.png[/img]

We didn't stop there though! We've also implemented the [b]Dyeing Station[/b] where you can dye [b]Clothing Items[/b] and [b]Gliders[/b]!Once you've purchased the Dyeing Station blueprint from Roman you can dye anything and everything!

[b]What paint brushes would you like to suggest to add?[/b]

[h1]Seedmaker[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/436152d0299abe95c746dc169d8e3ea8c85f433a.png[/img]

You asked for it and we delivered! This is something that wasn't on our radar until the [b]community[/b] brought it up and wow do we love it! The Seedmaker is a game changer in Garden Paws, with it you can turn [b]one mature plant into 1-2 seeds[/b]!

Sammy will deliver the Seedmaker blueprint to you in the mail on the first day of your first winter. (Don't worry if you've passed the day, you'll still receive the mail.)

[h1]New Caves![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/2b491bc3900a85e6a1748277a05e5b309c65b80a.png[/img]

There are[b] two new caves[/b] in this update, one that you have to find and one that you can open up with the help of the Mayor and the Miners.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/a9c697090ee9de059a014979835b92e868a4d73d.png[/img]

After the earthquake has triggered you'll be able to work with the Miners to open up a new cave that will hold a precious new item, the [b]Crystal Geodes[/b]!

[b]Crystal Geodes [/b]are very similar to the Geodes, but drop Quartz and other crystals.

[h1]Increased Inventory[/h1]

Another huge thing we've been hearing from the community is to[b] increase the inventory size[/b]. In this update Boris has 2 new inventory upgrades available to increase your max inventory by [b]11 slots!![/b]

Another Inventory related feature we just added is the [b]Craft All button![/b]

[h1]New Gliders[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/63e4f67433c9ef4088b7b5e8967b24f482f3a553.gif[/img]

There are a whopping [b]10 New Gliders[/b]! Some are patterns on the original, others are more unique including the [b]Flower Glider, Butterfly Glider, Angel Glider[/b] and more! All of these gliders can also be [b]dyed[/b] to suit your character best! Each Glider can be purchased from [b]Alberto's Shop[/b], the Angel and Butterfly can be unlocked through Alberto's new [b]quest line[/b].

[h1]Item Shifter and More New Items![/h1]

Without writing a book on this update, we'll quickly sum up some of the other features and items you'll find in this update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/fc1b79aacf6db98a1eb9f88bdef045a574638ffd.gif[/img]

[b]Item Shifter: [/b]With the item shifter you will be able to [b]shift placed items[/b] left/right, up/down, back/forwards just a little bit. This is to aid in lining up building pieces.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/6bf86b14ab116b2a47781dcd4155aa94be08e2a7.png[/img]
[b]
Town Hall: [/b]The interior of the town hall has been added!!

[b]New Recipes: [/b]Popcorn, Honey Oat Cookie and Strawberry Ice cream!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/305b17e309ab8c4a991847c7f4fbc88479da67a8.png[/img]

[b]Guitar! [/b]There's a [b]fully playable[/b] guitar! [b]Clovis[/b] has it in their shop!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/b5aa51b0aea665a671af993e038123c824870009.gif[/img]

[b]Names above people in Multiplayer![/b] Tired of mixing up  your friend? Their names will show up above them in multiplayer now!

[b]Flower Planter: [/b]Purchase-able at Sierra's Shop after a short quest line.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/78827b4b5a6d9eae828c8dcc8a24d2d84d214cf1.png[/img]

[b]Roof Building Pieces: [/b]There are two new roof pieces that are [b]corner building pieces[/b] to create that perfect roof. (Yup there is a new paintbrush to give you a variety of [b]shingle roofs[/b] too!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/66078094cff9bffb91962963d9c27d308122bf90.png[/img]

[b]Paintings! [/b]There are [b]9 Paintings[/b], one is a Sad Cat painting by Daniel Snd, and 8 are screenshots taken in game. The paintings can be crafted at the Paint Workstation.

[b]Are there any paintings you'd like to see in Garden Paws?[/b]

[b]Abby [/b]now sells[b] Vegetable seeds[/b]!

The [b]window building piece[/b] has been adjusted to better suit our characters.

[b]Patch Notes [/b]have been added[b] in game[/b] on the main menu (bottom left).

[h1]What's Next[/h1]

Seeing as this update is so huge we may have missed some things in the update. We definitely get lost in our work but we are working on recording more of what we're updating in Garden Paws.

Our next step is the[b] Creative Mode[/b] as we've got it almost done, you'll probably see that come out [b]early June[/b]. Our main focus for June is the [b]Dungeon[/b] though!

We have almost everything ready for the dungeon, just need to tie it all together with a nice bow, add some more weapons, monsters and a little bit of everything.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/408dd80f73efff8bb7804fbc306230ad57c241e8.png[/img]

The dungeon levels will be [b]100% procedural[/b] with lots of loot to find and sell in your shop. If you don't want to garden at all you should still find enough loot to progress at a steady pace through the game. If you don't want to go near the dungeon or fight anything you're not going to miss out on any of the main content.

[h1]June 12th is One Year Anniversary Community Event![/h1]

[b]Dan, Kristina and Thiago[/b] started developing Garden Paws [b]June 12th last year (2018)[/b]. For this very important anniversary we wanted to host a community event on one of our servers for up to 32 people!

The event will go live[b] June 12th at 12PM PST[/b] for a minimum of 6 hours. We have a maze, a jump puzzle, and will be doing races to earn prizes! This server is being built by Kristina and the beta testers and will have tons of goodies, we hope to see you there!

If you don't want to or can't join the server we will be streaming it on twitch as well.

[h1]1.1.0 is now live![/h1]

Every day 15 in Spring you'll be able to meet [b]Ester the Easter Bunny[/b] in Florens! We hope you like hunting for Easter Eggs because with the help of the townsfolk Ester has hidden [b]20 Eggs[/b] for you to collect!

[i]The colourful Egg Cracking Station![/i]

Once you find an egg you can bring it back to Ester to crack it open for [b]Bunny Tickets[/b] and other goodies like Geodes, Equipment and even Gold Poop! If you find one of the [b]rare eggs[/b] you'll have a chance to get rare items including Fairy Wings, Gems and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/eea971ab75ca68ed228bc09e56f5f9ab86f1ba06.png[/img]

[i]Some of the Aprons coming into Garden Paws! Do you have a favourite?[/i]

[*]  [b]2 Rainbow Dragon Skins[/b]
[*]  [b]4 New Crowns[/b] (Including a Flower Crown and Golden Egg Crown)
[*]  [b]18 Aprons[/b] (Can be equipped in your accessory slot so you can still wear clothes, if you'd like.)

[*]  [b]Flower Fountain[/b]
[*]  [b]Egg Flower Centerpiece[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/342b158bc0c1a636766ea076ae60589ad6f4084b.png[/img]
[i]Golden Egg Crown anyone?[/i]

Since switching over to [b]Bolt[/b] to host our Multiplayer Servers we have noticed a HUGE boost in Multiplayer performance. There have been a couple bugs that have been brought to our attention and this update has addressed them. This includes the bug where some people would get the [b]"Session Connection Failed"[/b] error.

We are constantly working on this feature and will be addressing any bugs that come up as we're made aware of them. We [b]appreciate[/b] your patience as we tackle Multiplayer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/74e73915cb61121fa1505bd3438322a7776254a9.png[/img]

Here's some of what you can expect to see in Garden Paws in the next[b] few months[/b]:

notes.title: March Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]1.0.7 is now live![/h1]

Multiplayer is our main focus for the next update. Dan (our programmer) will be replacing the multiplayer middleware. This means a complete revamp of the multiplayer code. As we are just a small team of 3 (Daniel, Kristina and Thiago), please bear with us as we get the multiplayer patched up.

[h1]Horseys![/h1]

The horse playable character has been added. (Thanks to one of our Kickstarter Designer Backers!)

There's now a horse mount and stable. You can also ride many of the larger farm animals!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/79986e45b2dec8f460cc156cd08cfdcaf91d7a06.gif[/img]

[h1]Assistant[/h1]

There's an assistant! You can now hire an assistant to run your shop, for a % of the sales that is.

notes.title: A Huge Update for January!
notes.notes:
[h1]A Huge Update for January![/h1]

First off Thank You from the Devs of this little project; Dan, Kristina, and Thiago for all your wonderful support as we make Garden Paws. Every supportive tweet, review, message is incredible and we thank you dearly as we put our hearts into Garden Paws. 

Being a small team of two developers and a composer is definitely a ton of work but we're really proud of how far Garden Paws has come in the last few months and are excited for 2019! To start it off we have a huge content update!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/9b2aa5aa0cf10816c58c3b2cb619df6b2535b406.png[/img]

[h1]What's in this update:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Full In-Game Controller Support
[*] Sprinklers
[*] Discount Bin
[*] Museum and Collections
[*] The Inn-terior for the Inn and Museum
[/list]

[b]New Items:[/b]
[list]
[*] Compost Bin and a fertilizer recipe change
[*] Furnace
[*] Large Stone and Wood Storage Sheds
[*] 8 (16 slot) "decorative" chests
[*] Marble Display Cases, Anvil, New Wings, Pumpkin Planter, 13 new crops
[*] And lots, lots more. (Read more below..)
[/list]

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]

Implementing the full controller support has been a huge priority for us and we're glad to say it's fully implemented in-game. The main menu is the only area it's not 100% in yet, and Dan will be working on this over the next couple days.

[h1]Sprinklers[/h1]

We heard the community and have added sprinklers. They come in 3 tiers, Copper, Silver and Gold. The blueprint is not available at the start of the game but will be unlocked as you play, if you'd like some spoilers we suggest you join our wonderful community over on discord by following this link: [url=https://discord.gg/QXseXfR]https://discord.gg/QXseXfR[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/196d9b0a2322b49d06e8a4dbe5317bf2dae76ad8.png[/img]

[h1]Discount Bin[/h1]

We've heard you might want to get rid of all those insects and other items quickly and at a discount. With that, we've added the Discount Bin! Any items you place in the discount bin will sell for half price at the end of the day, this item is upgradeable with Frank.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/7e9ec4af5defaa445ff02e52c7a38413ec385f8e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Museum and Collections[/h1]

The first stages of the Museum has been added, with 15 collections to fulfill and more to come later. Once you complete a collection you'll be rewarded with new items and possibly even some information on how to tame a furry friend.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/40ade582a2984bb88ed5d95be5dce04b98f0b16f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Inn[/h1]

Sadie's rustic inn has been built, with your help of course. The Inn brings along some new quests and soon a new shop where you'll be able to purchase your favourite beverages and Sadie's famous grilled fish!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/315f4cc6903cc71decf21e9c77a7004a986b5b6a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Compost Bin[/h1]

The fertilizer can now be crafted in the Compost Bin, and with a new recipe. It now takes 5 poop and only 1 wheat to make 5 fertilizer overnight. Fertilizer takes 0 stamina to use, and has a 25% chance to yield a seed when harvesting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/0a3da57a25fd8e06ca2ecf5efcca518f727b0c01.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]

Beltran isn't the only Blacksmith in town anymore! Build yourself a Furnace and Anvil to start smelting ores and sand from anywhere. There are also quite a few new quests that will teach you how to make one of the many new storage chests. 

This last month we've added even more new items including; Black and Gold Wings, Rainbow Fairy Wings, Pumpkin and Stone Planters, Glass and more. We've also added a lot of new skins including the "Glow" skin set that is available for every current character in 6 colour variations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/708943e129db79e8304f39cf4356352143269c18.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other Notes:[/h1]

Minor improvements towards the optimization, the February update will be heavily focussed on optimizing the game as well as improving multiplayer.

We've seen a relatively frequent problem arise with connection issues that has usually been resolved by disabling firewalls or switching who hosts the lobby. If you have any problems with multiplayer please contact Dan or Kristina, (the two devs), and we'll be happy to help.

You can contact us through Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/QXseXfR]https://discord.gg/QXseXfR[/url]
or email (Admin@BittenToast.com)

The map has been updated with the new islands, a sound has been added when you take a screenshot with F8, and many more small fixes are in this update.

[h1]The Next Update[/h1]

We will be doing a small patch in a couple days, after that we'll be doing a heavy optimization update. This update will be focused around improving multiplayer and overall performance. As much as we'd like to do another huge content update, we feel this is more important at this stage.

As our only programmer, Dan will be mainly focussing on optimization for February. Kristina, (the other dev), will be working on the Creative Mode and a new shop that will sell all your Landscaping needs. Thiago, (our composer), will be, and has been working on the seasons music as well as compiling the soundtrack for it's release.

We hope you've been enjoying Garden Paws, and again Thank you for all your support! Every positive tweet, review, and comment means the world to us! 

If you'd like to see the full patch-notes check the Patchnotes channel in our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/QXseXfR]https://discord.gg/QXseXfR[/url]

notes.title: More Animals to raise!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/a213303b568748bd72e86e924590edc6b0260633.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Quests[/h1]
Charlie needs your help building a Guard Tower for those cold Winter nights! Among this quest line and more we currently have 276 quests to complete in Garden Paws. We are constantly adding more quests and hope to hit 300 very soon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/e684fdab42ae19ecbe204d196e569e976bc8a535.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Animals![/h1]
This latest update we have been working on adding more animals to raise on your farm!

[b]Here are the new animals:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Lamb[/b] (mature: Sheep)
[*] [b]Baby Goat [/b](mature: Goat)
[*] [b]Baby Alpaca[/b] (mature: Alpaca)
[*] [b]Duckling[/b] (mature: Duck)
[*] [b]Mallard Duckling[/b] (mature: Mallard Duck)
[/list]

Each animal can be matured in the barn, or for the ducks, the Duck Pond. 

Each animal can also be equipped through your pet slot in your inventory. With all these new items we've added 2 more upgrades for the Barn and Duck Pond so you can increase the capacity from 3 to 6 if you'd like.

[h1]New items:[/h1]
With new animals, come new items! Here's a quick list of what's been added.

[list]
[*] Duck Feathers, Duck Eggs, Gold Poop, Goat Milk, Wool, Alpaca Fiber  
[*] Sand and Sand Dollars. Which can be gathered from piles along the beach.   
[*] Coal and Marble rocks that can be found in the ruins caves. 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/7c93cdeebebdac614e0c9f4b55e1f78ddd3c4f2d.jpg[/img]

Rain isn't going to stop us from having fun! Rainy days are great, you don't have to water your crops!

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
We have steadily been improving the performance for multiplayer as well as fixing some bugs, the latest patch should run even smoother.

A quick note, we've noticed that some firewalls protect against people joining you or you joining an online lobby, if you're experiencing this, that could be why. We have also been suggesting switching who hosts the lobby, this has resulted in a more stable game experience.

If you're experiencing problems with multiplayer or any other aspect to the game, we welcome you to join our discord or email us, we'll be happy to help.

[url=www.gardenpawsgame.com/discord]www.gardenpawsgame.com/discord[/url] - admin@bittentoast.com

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/2ec5269f9ffa13c05b915d77a1fe6dd81d894739.jpg[/img]

Just a dragon looking for some tasty fish, nothing to see here.

[h1]Other Notes[/h1]
You can now name chests and lock them, chests are locked by default in multiplayer.

Sammy now only sells Spring + Summer seeds, with a new seller introduced Fall day 1 that will sell Fall + Winter seeds permanently.

In the last update we added (!) on the Anvil, and a few other places when you interact with them the first time. This will prompt a screen to pop up with helpful tips.

The hot bar scroll direction has been reversed, if you'd like to change it or any other settings you can do so in the main menu under "Controls".

Tips have been added on the loading screen.

Milk stacks have been increased from 10 to 30.

[h1]From the Devs[/h1]
As always we'd like to give a big Thank You to everyone that has supported us so far, with your tweets, reviews, and just sharing the game in general. We plan on one more update before the new year with a small surprise.

What are we working on next?

Dan and Kristina are currently working on adding more content, while squishing any bugs that pop up of course. The next content updates that we have planned, without giving too many spoilers, include a fast travel system, a furnace to smelt ores, and the Museum.

This is just our short term update list, we're also working on the Dungeon, Cooking and more. But, those are a bit further out.

Thiago (our audio dev) has been working on the music for the Seasons, each Fall and Winter will rotate to new soundtrack.

With Winter we introduced snow, we're happy to say[b] rain[/b] has also been implemented! Now on [b]rainy days[/b] you can leave your watering can at home! 


[b][h1]What's next..[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/6bf7db4258d2006e2ae6263df6b3d6ee3db02b19.png[/img]

The three of us here at [b]Bitten Toast Games[/b] Thank You for your support and are excited for the next phase of [b]Garden Paws[/b]!

[i]Daniel Snd, Kristina Vandale and Thiago Adamo[/i]

notes.title: We launch on December 18th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/9cbbc60ac70b59523b0f257c16349ae9ad730a76.png[/img]

[h1][b]We launch on December 18th![/b][/h1]

In just a few days we'll be launching on Steam and sending out Kickstarter keys! These keys will be for [b]PC and Mac[/b].

This last month, (or few months), have been really busy for us three but we're really proud about how far the game has come. We will still be launching updates, with [b]1 major one every month until mid 2019[/b]. The last half of 2019 we will be focusing on optimizing the game further as well as porting to the Switch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/7426358c20f8ba65ff9a8237c2196cd8bbfa1b00.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Seasons[/b][/h1]

In [b]Fall and Winter[/b] you'll not only notice the new plants popping up, you'll also see tons of visual changes. In Fall the trees will be changing to Red, Orange and Yellow tones and Winter everything will be covered in Snow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/b66b5fb3ef1df7aff3a08d19d2dcc440e28bd62b.png[/img]

[h1][b]43 Current Crops! [/b][/h1]

With Seasons implemented we have added [b]28 New Plants[/b], giving us a grand total of 43 crops. The plants are seasonal with new plants sprouting up in the Fall and Winter. We have lots more crops planned, what would you like to grow in Garden Paws?

When farming, keep in mind your crops will take longer to grow in the cold harsh soil of Winter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/bc822351108b5206f18d2fb3769164e4ea8574f7.png[/img]

[h1][b]Two New Characters: The Chipmunk and the Dragon![/b][/h1]

Thanks to two of our kickstarter backers, [b]octoberGods and Skywings14[/b] we have 2 great new playable characters.

Each one is coming in with lots of skins ot choose from, with more to come! Currently we have [b]7 playable characters in Garden Paws![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/e8079718042fd32ea293e8e33a2ced603e5aab5e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Cooking[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ee1db7dd5fa289a3a6d19fd864b3ff3499f4d5f9.png[/img]

We've started implementing the first stages of cooking, the Campfire and Grill. This craft-able item, when placed, will be able to grill up fish into a nice [b]energy boosting treat[/b]. 

We plan on having an extensive cooking system, including 10+ Cooking Stations with each recipe requiring one step, to 10. The more difficult the recipe is, the more coin you'll earn from selling it, or the more energy you'll earn by consuming it.

We do plan on having buffs coming from certain dishes, but this won't be implemented until the dungeon is ready to come into Garden Paws.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/88f82cbf337245f10f6648fd00cb7a16fa113807.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Clothing and Accessories[/b][/h1]

For the last month we had 3 Limited Edition costume pieces, as kind of a bonus Thank You to our Alpha backers on Kickstarter. These costumes have been removed and replaced with new costumes, the [b]Witch Costume[/b] and the [b]Magicians Costume[/b]. 

We have more items that have been recently added into Garden Paws, with lots more clothing pieces to come. If you have any suggestions on pieces you'd like, comment below or let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/MZvdHxD]Discord (click here)[/url].

Along with Costumes, we have new skins that have been added that are obtainable in Treasure Chests, through quests or from Splash's Shop.

[h1][b]Thank you![/b][/h1]

We're excited to launch Garden Paws to the public and can't wait to hear what you think of our game.

Daniel, Kristina & Thiago

notes.title: What's in the Alpha
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/35ec628d9ebf611f60de54aa2d265ecbf882d8d9.png[/img]

[b][h1] Only 1 month until we launch on Steam! [/h1][/b]
This past month has been going incredibly well! We've [b]doubled the amount of quests in game, added a new playable character, fishing, and lots lots more![/b]

The main thing we're incredibly proud about is hearing from our alpha players that they've been able to get [b]50+ hours of gameplay[/b]. We're proud of the [b]optimization[/b] and the sheer amount of features that we currently have in Garden Paws.

You'll definitely be suprised with how much is in this early access title.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/5cf4405951e11e75b64e19b9744918f730055f8f.png[/img]

[h1]Here's what you can find already in the Alpha of Garden Paws:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 5 Playable Characters (Cat, Bunny, Fox, Bear, Badger)
[*] Run a shop to sell everything from Poop to Bouquets
[*] 200+ Quests over 2 islands
[*] Raise chicks to chickens and calves to cows
[*] 40+ crafting and building recipes
[*] Farming
[*] Fishing
[*] Multiplayer, and even Twitch Integration
[*] 60+ Clothing and Accessory Items
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/d4e730d2a8dd530af9170c2cc84244a0adbd381f.jpg[/img]

[h1] Here's what we'll be working on next [/h1]
[list]
[*] [i]Getting better at posting more Steam updates...[/i]
[*] Seasons, introducing 30+ new crops
[*] Controller Support
[*] Extensive Cooking (more on that in the next update)
[*] Achievements
[*] Procedural Dungeon
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/a841abdbf7403a5fcf55c2eb662b9cce67454e7b.png[/img]

[h1] Fishing! [/h1]
We recently did a poll in our Discord, to see what you'd like in game right away. Fishing and Cooking were the top 2 so we got started right away!

The fishing mini-game is incredibly satisfying with 10+ fish currently in, of our 40+ planned. Along with fishing we introduced Fish Nets and Shellfish Nets!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/78a85720158fcbb2c007e8c7ea7a8b9bc77bb3a3.png[/img]

[h1] Badger [/h1]
Thanks to one of our character designers, Killian, we've added another new playable character, the Badger!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/a6d4fc2714e4eedde88d7e805f8d1bf42e560750.png[/img]

[h1] Halloween Island [/h1]
We have built a whole new island that is full of spooky surprises, if you're in the Alpha, we highly recommend you check it out this fall for 3 Limited Edition costumes!

We will be replacing these costumes December 1st with permanent halloween themed ones, so make sure to grab them while you can.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/e0794ed20e116a7a4dd8c97dbbdf260c67bc3c11.png[/img]

[h1] Home Interiors [/h1]
Originally we built Garden Paws to not have an interior of the player home, this was mainly due to it not being high on the priority list. But, after hearing from the community we built the player home, and 40+ furniture pieces and craftables for the home.

This home is also upgrade-able if you'd like more room to store all your goodies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/7a0b9ba744928defafbc20e34ae912ec3df545a6.png[/img]

[h1] Craftables [/h1]
We currently have 40+ Building pieces and other craftable items in Garden Paws. Including our latest addition, Bouquets!

Bouquets are a great way to earn some extra coin, instead of selling one flower at a time  you can craft some paper, and wrap up a few flowers to sell all at once in a beautiful bouquet!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ebc5cdd9290b35aacd662abcf09fdaa4f720deb7.png[/img]

[h1] Customization [/h1]
We've definitely heard from the community that you love customization. Along with the 5 playable characters, (thanks again to our incredible kickstarter backers!), we have 100+ skins ready to implement and 60+ clothing and accessory items.

We even have more playable characters and accessories coming in the future!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/380d2c92503ce46a863d4a0780a900e3b58f4cc6.png[/img]

[h1] Where to find the devs [/h1]
There are three developers of Garden Paws, Dan, Kristina and our audio designer Thiago. You can always find us on Discord where we are very active, or follow us on Twitter to stay up to date on what we're working on.

www.gardenpawsgame.com/discord
www.twitter.com/GardenPawsGame

notes.title: Alpha has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/ec724fe9cd645343ef47a55e2a85120729d89fcc.jpg[/img]

[h1] We're excited to announce the closed alpha has launched![/h1]

October 20th we released the alpha to Kickstarter and Backerkit backers!

Currently the alpha features 30+ hours of gameplay with some of the features you'll see in the final game including:

[list]
 [*] Run a shop selling everything from poop to crafted furniture.
 [*] Over 100 quests.
 [*] Raise chicks to chickens, or start taming wild animals like Bunnies.
 [*] Craft and build a home and furnishings.
 [*] Start farming with more than 10 crops currently available.
 [*] Multiplayer is in, currently with a max of 2 players per lobby.
[/list]

We have lots more coming to Garden Paws and thank everyone for their feedback from playing the demo and thank you everyone that is playing the closed alpha. 

We have the closed the alpha orders, the earliest you'll be able to play the full game is December of 2018, right here on steam. 

[h1] Here's what we're currently working on: [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228384/928d72d7e6a76c364d4c0079e0015a944c44d7b8.png[/img]

[list]
 [*] Our main priority is always fixing bugs right when they are spotted, we thank everyone that has helped us catch [i](and release)[/i] them right away.
 [*] We are working on the Halloween update that will be out in the next few days, including a whole new island, costumes, and more. 
 [*] The first furniture set has been implemented, including the bed which can be used to update your spawn point. We are working on more furniture sets.
 [*] Two habitats have been added to tame the Cat and Bunny with more taming options coming.
 [*] The next crafting workbench we hope to implement is the Flower Workstation, here you'll be able to craft bouquets and other items in the future.
 [*] The 4th playable character, the Fox, has been added. And thanks to our Character Design backers on Kickstarter, we'll have more playable characters coming to Garden Paws.
[/list]

There are three of us that have been hard at work since before the Kickstarter, and we wont be paws-ing our work anytime soon.

In the last couple months we have been working on the core mechanics of Garden Paws as well as some fun features like Twitch Integration.

[i] With Twitch Integration any viewers that have typed in chat in the past 6 minutes, will show up as a customer in your shop in Garden Paws. [/i]

As always, we welcome you to join our Garden Paws discord.
